releases.title: 英文版界面上线，站点能切换中英文
body: 站点有了英文版，界面能整体切换成英文了。
- 新增英文版入口，英文页面带 /en 前缀；侧边栏与「更多」页都能切换语言。
- 英文版优先显示信源原题与原文正文；AI 摘要与日报仍为中文。

en.title: English interface is live, and the site can switch languages
body: The site now has an English edition, and the whole interface can switch to English.
- A new English entry point: English pages use the /en prefix, and the sidebar and the More page can both switch languages.
- English pages show the source's original headline and article body first; AI summaries and the daily report stay in Chinese.

releases.title: 后台用量读数提速，角标不再偶发报错
body: 后台用量总览与按天翻查不再拖着整张标签表一起扫，十几秒的等待基本消失。
每笔调用的服务与用途随流水一并落行：事后改标签会同步补到历史行，翻旧账不再读到旧口径。
重聚合窗口里角标偶发超时会先沿用上一次数值再自动重算，不再整页报错；读者页面与账单不受影响。

en.title: Admin usage figures load faster; occasional badge errors end
body: The admin usage overview and day-by-day lookups no longer scan the whole tag table, so the ten-second-plus wait is mostly gone.
Each call's service and purpose are stored in the same row as its ledger entry: tag edits made later are backfilled onto historical rows, so old records no longer show the old wording.
During a re-aggregation window, a badge timeout now falls back to the previous value and recomputes automatically instead of erroring the whole page; reader pages and billing are unaffected.

releases.title: 历史台账、时代史与目录地图
body: 全仓 1714 个提交逐条落成台账，另按四段时间写成主题史，并补一份目录地图说明各部分职责。
清理候选与安全复核只出清单：删除、搬移与凭据轮换都等站长逐条确认后再动。
这一条只补文档，站点功能、采集与发布流程都没有变化。

en.title: Commit ledger, era history, and a project map
body: All 1714 commits in the repository are recorded one by one in a ledger, with a thematic history in four periods and a project map that explains what each part does.
Cleanup candidates and the security review produced lists only: deletions, moves, and credential rotation wait for the site owner to confirm each item.
This entry adds documents only; site features, collection, and publishing are unchanged.

releases.title: 后台多了信源发现页
body: 后台新增「信源发现」页：多个搜索 API 并行找候选，同站交叉验证后再现场抓 feed，过质量门的才进待审队列。
候选不会直接进正式池：管理员批准才写入，默认暂停；拒绝要写原因，每条都留着引擎证据。
不写文章、不调用模型、不产生费用；池满时先退役一个源，再批准。

en.title: A source-discovery page for the admin
body: The admin has a new Source Discovery page: several search APIs look for candidates in parallel, results are cross-checked on the same site, then the feed is fetched live; only sources that pass the quality gate enter the review queue.
Candidates never enter the main pool directly: an admin must approve them, and approved sources start paused. A rejection needs a reason, and every entry keeps the engine evidence.
It writes no articles, calls no models, and costs nothing. When the pool is full, a source retires before another is approved.

releases.title: 后台不再排队等连接
body: 读者 API 的连接池从 2 调到 8、调度队列的连接 3：健康探针不再超时，信源页从 40 秒回到 277 毫秒。
改完要逐台读回进程的真实环境变量，不能只看 .env——systemd 的配置文件会覆盖它。

en.title: Admin no longer queues for connections
body: The reader API connection pool went from 2 to 8, and the scheduler queue has 3 connections: health probes no longer time out, and the sources page went from 40 seconds to 277 milliseconds.
Each machine's real process environment has to be read back after the change; the .env file alone is not enough, because the systemd config file overrides it.

releases.title: 信源补位不再写不进库
body: 7.0 的补位脚本把参与方式当列名写进插入语句，候选转正时那一行写不进库。
改成按值绑定后，替换仍在同一事务里一停一启，失败源先进隔离区，再由已核验的候选顶上。

en.title: Source replacement writes to the database again
body: The 7.0 replacement script wrote the participation mode as a column name in its INSERT, so the row could not be saved when a candidate was promoted.
Now bound by value, replacement still stops and starts inside one transaction: a failed source enters quarantine first, then a verified candidate takes its place.

releases.title: 每一笔模型调用，都有一本明白账
body: 订阅、免费、无公开价与公开 API 刊例分开记；价卡带版本，汇率与官方价每天核对。
模型冷却按账号停用、日额度、分钟限流与连接失败分开处理，后台写明恢复条件。
用量首次统计不再显示假的零；旧数据保留并标明时间，后台忙时也不装死。

en.title: Every model call now has a ledger that adds up
body: Subscription, free, no-public-price, and public API list prices are recorded separately; price cards carry versions, and exchange rates and official prices are checked daily.
Model cooldowns are split by account suspension, daily quota, per-minute rate limit, and connection failure, and the admin states the recovery condition for each.
First usage totals no longer show a fake zero; old data is kept with its timestamp, and the admin no longer freezes when it is busy.

releases.title: 两千个信源，坏一个补一个
body: 正式采集一千条、备用候选一千条；备用源定期复核，坏掉的入口由同类别、已核验的候选顶上。
备用只收公开 RSS 与 JSON 入口，复核不写文章、不调用模型，也不产生费用。
连续失败、长时间没有成功的正式源才替换；每轮最多两个，切换一停一启并写审计。

en.title: Two thousand sources, a thousand live and a thousand spare
body: 1,000 active collection sources and 1,000 backup candidates; backups are reviewed on a schedule, and a broken entry is replaced by a verified candidate in the same category.
Backups take only public RSS and JSON feeds; a review writes no articles, calls no models, and costs nothing.
Only active sources that fail repeatedly or go a long time without success are replaced; at most two per round, each switched with a stop and start and recorded in the audit log.

releases.title: 用量恢复与 Magpie 流式加载
body: 用量快照首次生成条件与资源巡检对齐，891MiB 读者机不再因常态内存压力永久停在“正在生成统计”。
Magpie 白名单静态资源改为流式转发，供应商图标目录补全，大脚本不再整包缓冲进 API 堆。
读者机 API 内存上限与 V8 堆单独设置；是否彻底消除 OOM 仍看部署后的重启计数与真实请求。

en.title: Usage recovery and streamed Magpie assets
body: The condition for the first usage snapshot now matches the resource check, so the 891MiB reader machine no longer sits forever at "Generating statistics" under constant memory pressure.
Allowlisted Magpie static assets are streamed instead of buffered; the vendor icon directory is complete, and large scripts no longer land whole in the API heap.
The reader machine's API memory limit and V8 heap are set separately; whether OOM is truly gone still depends on restart counts and real requests after deployment.

releases.title: 后台用量与 Magpie 面板补齐
body: 用量聚合遇到同一模型一部分小时无有效价卡、一部分有价时不再中断，今日、本月和筛选结果继续生成。
单次统计读取截止放宽到 30 秒，后台快照异步刷新；Magpie 静态白名单补供应商图标目录，脚本加载不占 API 限流。
运维文档同步面板 API 1200 次/分钟、必需检查与 nginx 改配置后的生效步骤。

en.title: Admin usage and Magpie panel gaps closed
body: Usage aggregation no longer stops when one model has some hours without a valid price card and some with one; today, this month, and filtered results keep generating.

The timeout for a single statistics read is now 30 seconds, and the admin snapshot refreshes asynchronously; the Magpie static allowlist gained the vendor icon directory, and script loads no longer use the API rate limit.
The ops docs now record the panel API's 1200 requests per minute, the required checks, and the steps to make an nginx config change take effect.

releases.title: 费用折算把订阅免费无公开价分开
body: 后台用量页按官方价卡折算：实际账单优先；订阅制、免费、查不到公开价的模型分列，不再混进 API 单价。
价卡改为版本化记录，汇率取最新落库值；缺标注项不阻塞出账。
查不到官方价就标无公开价，不估算，也不套用相似模型的价。

en.title: Cost conversion separates subscription, free, and no-public-price
body: The admin usage page converts costs with official price cards and puts actual bills first; subscription, free, and no-public-price models are listed separately and no longer mixed into API unit prices.
Price cards are now versioned records, and the exchange rate uses the latest stored value; a missing annotation does not block billing.
When no official price is found, the model is marked no public price; nothing is estimated, and no similar model's price is borrowed.

releases.title: 有残留的正文先不上公开全文
body: 正文若只剩同意墙、模板壳、站点工具栏残渣或参考文献，会先判为有缺陷，读者只看到摘要，不进完整正文。
地震、气象这类结构化短公报不受影响，仍按速报展示；修复并重新过完工作流后才翻回公开。

en.title: Bodies with leftover junk stay out of public full text
body: If an article body is only a consent wall, a template shell, site toolbar debris, or references, it is marked defective; readers see the summary only, not the full text.
Structured short bulletins such as earthquake and weather reports are not affected and still appear as flash reports; a body returns to public only after repair and a full workflow rerun.

releases.title: 信源池数量按正式与备用并集统计
body: 后台信源页的池总数改为正式启用与备用候选的并集，两边不再重复计数。
备用候选单列新鲜度：7 天内校验过的可用，过期或隔离的分开标注。

en.title: Source pool count is now the active-plus-backup union
body: The pool total on the admin sources page is now the union of active and backup candidates, so neither side is counted twice.
Backup candidates show freshness separately: those checked within 7 days are usable, while expired or quarantined ones are labeled apart.

releases.title: 模型冷却写明证据时间和恢复条件
body: 后台模型页按失败类别区分冷却：连接超时、账号停用、日额度、分钟限流、待处理、未知。
每条冷却带上证据时间与恢复条件；未知结果不盲目重放，第二次未知留给后台判断。
配置缺失类错误不再把普通 4xx 一并冷却。

en.title: Model cooldowns state evidence time and recovery condition
body: The admin model page splits cooldowns by failure: connection timeout, account suspension, daily quota, per-minute rate limit, pending, and unknown.
Each cooldown carries the evidence time and recovery condition; an unknown result is not blindly replayed, and a second unknown is left to the admin.
Configuration-missing errors no longer put ordinary 4xx responses into cooldown as well.

releases.title: 池子里那个 hy4 换成了真正的限免版
body: 站长指出上游的限免模型叫 hy4 flash，不是带 preview 的那个内部代号。
注册表与五台机器的池子都改成 hy4-flash，国际版桥实测仍被渠道拒绝，中国版与 magpie 都答话。
顺手把早就 404 的 auto-hy3 摘掉，免得它每天继续白占一个成员位。

en.title: The pool's hy4 is now the real free-tier model
body: The site owner pointed out that the upstream free-tier model is called hy4 flash, not the internal codename with preview.
The registry and the pools on five machines now use hy4-flash; the international bridge is still rejected by the channel in tests, while the China version and magpie both answer.
auto-hy3, which had long returned 404, was also removed so it stops wasting a member slot every day.

releases.title: hy3 退场，hy4 flash 上岗
body: 模型池里的 hy3 全部换成 hy4 flash：中国版桥与服务器 magpie 两条路各占一个成员位。
两条路都实测过 1-token 请求能答话；国际版桥当天对每个模型都回渠道拒绝，暂时留在池外。
旧别名同时退休，避免工作流继续点名一个已经不在上游的模型。

en.title: hy3 retires and hy4 flash takes over
body: Every hy3 in the model pool is replaced with hy4 flash: the China-version bridge and the server magpie each hold one member slot.
Both paths answered a 1-token test request; the international bridge returned a channel rejection for every model that day, so it stays out of the pool for now.
The old aliases retired at the same time, so workflows stop naming a model that is no longer upstream.

releases.title: agnes 调到最强推理档
body: 国际站与国内站两扇 agnes 门的推理强度从 high 提到 max。
同一个问题实测隐藏推理量 low 183 < high 196 < max 203 token，档位确实被上游采纳。
模型本身已经是两家端点当时最新的一代（agnes-3.0-flash），并写进 .env.example 便于迁移。

en.title: agnes moved to its strongest reasoning setting
body: The two agnes gateways, for the international and domestic sites, moved reasoning effort from high to max.
On the same question, measured hidden reasoning was low 183 < high 196 < max 203 tokens, so upstream does honor the setting.
The model itself was already the newest generation at both endpoints at the time (agnes-3.0-flash), and it is now in .env.example to ease migration.

releases.title: 数据库调优不再自己踩雷
body: 机器上手写的回收延迟超出了 PostgreSQL 允许的范围，
重启数据库会直接起不来。这段配置搬进仓库由部署同步，
并加了范围测试，下次重启前就能拦住。

en.title: Database tuning no longer sets its own trap
body: The vacuum delay written by hand on the machine was outside the range PostgreSQL allows,
so a database restart would fail to start. The setting moved into the repository and deploys sync it,
and a range test now catches the problem before the next restart.

releases.title: 预热不再趁火打劫
body: 机器被换页压住时，预热带每分钟还在给冷缓存点一次火。
现在 io 或内存压力到线就跳过，读者面照旧吃 stale 缓存。
阈值 60/40，可用 GEOHOT_WARM_MAX_IO 与 GEOHOT_WARM_MAX_MEM 调。

en.title: Warmup no longer piles on during a crisis
body: When the machine was pinned by swapping, the warmup timer still warmed the cold cache once a minute.
Now it skips once io or memory pressure hits the line, and readers still get the stale cache.
The thresholds are 60/40, and they can be tuned with GEOHOT_WARM_MAX_IO and GEOHOT_WARM_MAX_MEM.

releases.title: 主库换页时自己重启
body: 内存压力到线就重启 api 与 web，把它们被换出的页收回来。
现场实测：io some avg10 从 98.57 掉到 7.02，健康检查从 17.6 秒回到 5 毫秒。
阈值 40/60、两次动手至少隔 30 分钟，只碰这两个单元。

en.title: Restart when the primary starts swapping
body: When memory pressure hits the line, api and web restart and take back their swapped-out pages.
Measured on the machine: io some avg10 fell from 98.57 to 7.02, and the health check went from 17.6 seconds back to 5 milliseconds.
The thresholds are 40/60, actions are at least 30 minutes apart, and only these two units are touched.

releases.title: 备用信源不再是空账
body: 后台那栏「备用」读的是备用登记表，而池子里 1,064 条停用信源从没登记过，页面才一直停在 330。
新增补齐工具：逐条真抓一次，能用就登记为可用，不能用也登记为隔离并写明原因，跑完页面显示的就是真数。
顺手把开发库那个 postgres 控制台窗口藏掉，本地起数据库不再在桌面留一个黑框。

en.title: Backup sources are no longer a blank ledger
body: The Backup column in the admin reads the backup registry, but 1,064 disabled sources in the pool had never been registered, so the page stayed at 330.
A new backfill tool fetches each source for real: usable ones are registered as usable, unusable ones as quarantined with a reason, and after a run the page shows the real number.
The postgres console window for the dev database was also hidden, so starting the database locally no longer leaves a black box on the desktop.

releases.title: 白天只让一台机器做分析
body: 四台执行器白天各开一个分析槽之后，主库那块慢盘的 io 压到 99%，后台登录开始 504，健康检查要 464 秒。
白天改成只留离主库最近的一台做分析，另外三台照样采集、照样提取正文，分析槽写 0（这条车道单独计数，不影响别的活）。
夜里十一点照旧全开；真要提升吞吐，先把盘换成能扛住四个分析器的。

en.title: Only one machine runs analysis in the daytime
body: After four executors each opened one analysis slot in the daytime, io on the primary's slow disk hit 99%, admin logins began returning 504, and the health check took 464 seconds.

Daytime now leaves only the machine nearest the primary doing analysis; the other three still collect and extract body text, with their analysis slot set to 0 (this lane is counted separately and does not affect other work).
At 11 pm all of them open as before; to really raise throughput, the disk has to be replaced with one that can carry four analyzers.

releases.title: 后台面板不再跟读者抢限速桶
body: Magpie 面板一次要取四五十个资源，跟读者共用 2 次/秒的桶时一半请求被判 429，面板只剩导航栏。
后台与接口路径不再进这个桶，她们在服务端有自己的预算与会话校验；静态资源与真实读者照旧各自计数。
入口限制的片段同时收进仓库，部署会连 conf.d 里的同名副本一起对齐，改仓库不再出现线上不变。

en.title: Admin panel no longer fights readers for the rate-limit bucket
body: The Magpie panel fetches forty or fifty assets at once; when it shared the readers' 2-requests-per-second bucket, half its requests got a 429 and only the navigation bar was left.
Admin and API paths no longer enter that bucket; they have their own budget and session checks on the server. Static assets and real readers are still counted separately.
The entry-limit snippet is also kept in the repository now, and deploys align the copy of the same name in conf.d, so a repository edit no longer leaves production unchanged.

releases.title: 后台的 Magpie 面板不再被限速打空
body: 嵌在后台里的 Magpie 面板一次要拉几十上百个资源，再加每秒一次的分流追踪——240/分钟的桶一开就满。
资源拿到 429、脚本缺件，面板只剩导航栏；真浏览器实测一次加载里有 19 个 429。
代理这条路由的上限按面板的真实用量重定（仍是上限，只是不再卡住一个管理员的浏览器）。

en.title: The admin Magpie panel is no longer emptied by rate limits
body: The Magpie panel embedded in the admin pulls dozens to a hundred assets at once, plus a once-per-second traffic-split poll; the 240-per-minute bucket fills the moment it opens.
Assets got 429s and scripts went missing, leaving only the navigation bar; a real-browser test recorded 19 429s in a single load.
The proxy route's limit was reset to the panel's real usage (still a cap, just no longer choking one admin's browser).

releases.title: 没人结清的回执也留不住正文
body: 主库上还躺着 62,402 行停在 received 的回执：恢复机制早把它们判成未知，正文却一直在表里胀着。
结清的回执照旧一天丢正文；半路的给一周宽限，之后同样丢——行留着给统计，正文不留。
tests/receipts-payload-retention.test.ts 补一条：八天前的半路回执被清、一天内的还在。

en.title: Receipts nobody settles no longer keep their bodies
body: 62,402 receipts are still sitting at received on the primary: recovery marked them unknown long ago, but their bodies kept bloating the table.
Settled receipts still lose their bodies after one day; in-flight ones get a one-week grace and then lose them too: the row stays for statistics, the body does not.
tests/receipts-payload-retention.test.ts adds a case: an eight-day-old in-flight receipt is cleared, while one less than a day old remains.

releases.title: 模型池里不再留着死模型
body: 池子里躺着 11 个 magpie 已经不认的别名（79 个成员位），分派过去先撞一次 404 再换人——一小时里一半的失败是它们。
拿 1-token 探针逐个实测，把实测 404 的成员从五台机器的池子里摘掉，回执里的 404 会跟着少。
新增 tooling/model-pool-audit.mjs 与 prune-model-pool.sh：账号重新登进 magpie 后重跑探针即可。

en.title: Dead models are gone from the pool
body: The pool held 11 aliases magpie no longer recognizes (79 member slots); a dispatch would hit a 404 before switching, and they caused half the failures in an hour.
A 1-token probe tested each one; members that returned 404 were removed from the pools on five machines, so receipts carry fewer 404s.
New tooling/model-pool-audit.mjs and prune-model-pool.sh: rerun the probe after the account logs back into magpie.

releases.title: 白天不再整天停机
body: 杭州、武汉两台上同时躺着三套昼夜机制，其中一套每天七点把 worker 整个停掉，最新那套要用的脚本又没装。
于是白天没有任何分析在跑，积压堆到 2,163 条。现在只留一套：白天采集、正文提取加一个分析槽，夜里两个。
setup-executor-window.sh 负责装好脚本、关掉旧机制。

en.title: Daytime operation no longer shuts down all day
body: The Hangzhou and Wuhan machines each carried three day/night setups at once; one of them stopped the whole worker at 7 every day, and the script the newest one needed was not installed.
So no analysis ran during the day, and the backlog reached 2,163. Now only one mechanism remains: daytime collection, body extraction, and one analysis slot; two at night.
setup-executor-window.sh installs the script and turns off the old mechanisms.

releases.title: 订阅解析器补到 5.12
body: 上千个订阅源里的 XML 是外来的，解析器自己得扛得住畸形输入。
fast-xml-parser 从 5.11.1 补到 5.12.0，修掉未闭合标签让 CPU 平方级增长的那个洞（Dependabot #62）。
四十条订阅/XHTML/长文用例复跑通过。

en.title: Feed parser bumped to 5.12
body: The XML from thousands of feeds is foreign input, so the parser itself has to survive malformed data.
fast-xml-parser moved from 5.11.1 to 5.12.0, closing the hole where unclosed tags made CPU use grow quadratically (Dependabot #62).
Forty feed, XHTML, and long-form test cases passed on a rerun.

releases.title: 连点两下外观，选择不该丢
body: 外观切换用的是浏览器的视图过渡：第二次点击会把第一次的过渡作废，被作废那次的选择原本跟着没了——点了深色，界面还留在浅色。
现在过渡被作废时补做一次应用，并接住 ready 与 finished 两个拒绝，控制台也不再冒出 InvalidStateError。

en.title: Two quick appearance clicks should not lose the choice
body: The appearance switcher uses the browser's View Transition API: a second click cancels the first transition, and the choice from the cancelled one was lost with it. You picked dark, and the interface stayed light.
Now a cancelled transition still applies the change, both the ready and finished rejections are caught, and the console no longer prints InvalidStateError.

releases.title: 面板不再替攻击者列机器地址
body: 后台「服务器」页要的公网地址改由服务器自己的环境变量下发，仓库里不再写死。
页面上每台机器仍按地名相认，地址一栏照旧显示，只是不再随代码公开。
同时加了一条守卫：那个页面与接口里出现任何拨号地址都会让测试失败。

en.title: The panel no longer lists machine addresses for attackers
body: The public address the admin Servers page needs now comes from the server's env var, no longer hardcoded in the repo.
Each machine is still known by place name; the address column still shows, but is no longer published with the code.
A new guard fails the tests if any dial address appears on that page or in its API.

releases.title: 主题页不再每次重算
body: 主题页的条数缓存从一分钟放长到五分钟，和页面自己的缓存同频。
慢盘上这一次重算要扫十几万行，读的人越多越吃亏。
显式时钟的旁路保留给测试，判定行为不变。

en.title: Topic pages stop recomputing every time
body: The topic page count cache goes from 1 to 5 minutes, matching the page's own cache.
On a slow disk each recompute scans over 100,000 rows; the more readers, the worse it gets.
The explicit-clock bypass stays for tests, and the decision behaviour is unchanged.

releases.title: 凌晨回收不再把盘读死
body: 大表回收前先看磁盘压力，盘忙就跳过，留给下一个窗口。
回收自己带上让路的成本参数与 30 分钟上限，不再满速读几小时。
04:10 那个窗口昨天把一台 891 MB 的机器读到 load 30+，读者面掉到 10 秒。

en.title: The small-hours vacuum no longer pins the disk
body: Before vacuuming a large table it checks disk pressure; if the disk is busy it skips to the next window.
The vacuum now yields to other I/O and carries a 30-minute cap, instead of reading at full speed for hours.
Yesterday the 04:10 window pushed an 891 MB machine to load 30+, and the reader side fell to 10 seconds.

releases.title: 后台登录不再卡在磁盘上
body: 会话校验在进程内缓存 30 秒，后台每个接口不必再各读一次会话表。
磁盘被打满时，登录后打开页面不再等十几秒才出数据。
登出会立刻清掉本进程缓存，其它进程最多再认 30 秒。

en.title: Admin login stops stalling on disk
body: Session checks are cached in-process for 30 seconds, so each admin endpoint no longer reads the session table.
When the disk is saturated, pages open after login without waiting a dozen seconds for data.
Logout clears this process's cache at once; other processes may honour the session for up to 30 more seconds.

releases.title: 后台不再一页一页地转圈
body: 设置、模型、主题轮换、审计、用量五页都改成「30–120 秒内的旧值先给，后台再算」。
磁盘打满时这些页面以前会 503，现在最多慢一拍，不会再等到超时。
同一个缓存键的并发请求只会打一次数据库。

en.title: Admin pages stop spinning one after another
body: Settings, models, topic rotation, audit and usage now serve values 30–120 s old and recompute behind the scenes.
When the disk filled, these pages used to return 503; now they lag one beat at most and no longer wait for a timeout.
Concurrent requests for the same cache key hit the database once.

releases.title: 后台总览不再等到超时
body: 用量总览是几条按天聚合的大查询，慢盘上一次要几十秒，而页面每 30 秒就自动刷新一次。
现在结果在进程里缓存 60 秒：命中直接给，过期的旧值也先给、重算在后台跑，重算失败仍然给旧值。
响应头加了 x-admin-cache（fresh / stale / miss / stale-error），排查时一眼看得出是谁算的。

en.title: Admin overview stops waiting for a timeout
body: The usage overview runs a few daily aggregates, tens of seconds each on a slow disk, and the page refreshes every 30 s.
Results cache in-process 60 s: hits at once; stale values while a recompute runs behind; old values stay if it fails.
A response header x-admin-cache (fresh / stale / miss / stale-error) shows at a glance which path served it.

releases.title: 慢盘上不再自残
body: 时间线快照从 30 秒放到 10 分钟：一次聚合要扫十几万行，半分钟重算一次等于拿读者开玩笑。
部署快照只留最近 3 个（原来每部署一次留一个 187 MB 的包，一晚上就攒了 198 个）。
两条都写进了测试，防止有人再把它调回去。

en.title: No more self-harm on a slow disk
body: Timeline snapshot: 30 s → 10 min. One aggregate scans 100,000+ rows; a 30 s recompute was a joke at readers' expense.
Deploy snapshots keep only the latest 3 (each deploy used to leave a 187 MB bundle; one night piled up 198).
Tests pin both changes so nobody turns them back.

releases.title: 沙箱不再半小时掉一次
body: InstaBox 的免费档「30 分钟没人用就暂停」，而沙箱只往外连，平台看不到有人在用。
主库现在每 5 分钟打一次入向活动，机器一旦被暂停就立刻 /start 拉起，并把执行器从 /data 装回来。
顺带发现 /wake 对已暂停的机器会回 409，真正能救的是 /start。

en.title: The sandbox stops dropping every half hour
body: InstaBox's free tier pauses after 30 idle minutes, and the sandbox only connects outward, so the platform sees no use.
The primary sends inbound activity every 5 min; a paused machine gets /start at once and its executor back from /data.
Along the way: /wake returns 409 for an already-paused machine; /start is what actually rescues it.

releases.title: 第五台机器接进来了
body: InstaBox 沙箱（4 核 / 8 GB）接成第五个执行器：2 个分析槽，心跳在后台「服务器」页显示为 InstaBox。
免费档 30 分钟没人用会自动暂停，所以主库每 20 分钟打一次 /wake 记账，隧道与执行器不会睡过去。
面板的地名表补上 InstaBox 沙箱，不再把它的主机名原样显示。

en.title: A fifth machine joins the fleet
body: InstaBox sandbox (4 cores / 8 GB) is now the fifth executor: 2 analysis slots; heartbeat: InstaBox on admin Servers.
Free tier pauses after 30 idle minutes, so the primary sends /wake every 20 min to keep the tunnel and executor awake.
The panel's place-name table now lists the InstaBox sandbox instead of showing its bare hostname.

releases.title: 国内入口有了正式域名
body: cn.xxc2007.me 上线：灰云 A 记录直指华为云边缘，证书走 DNS-01 签发（HTTP-01 被备案拦截）。
国内实测 0.35–0.64 秒（杭州）、0.04–0.11 秒（上海命中边缘），对照经 Cloudflare 的 1.25–9.8 秒。
证书续期交给 cloudflare 插件自动完成，安装脚本新增 tls 子命令。

en.title: The China entry gets a proper domain
body: cn.xxc2007.me is live: grey-cloud A record at the Huawei Cloud edge; cert via DNS-01 (HTTP-01 blocked by ICP filing).
From China: 0.35–0.64 s in Hangzhou, 0.04–0.11 s in Shanghai on an edge hit, against 1.25–9.8 s via Cloudflare.
Certificate renewal is automatic through the cloudflare plugin; the install script gains a tls subcommand.

releases.title: 收据表的回收挪到凌晨
body: receipts 2.8 GB、8 万多死元组，autovacuum 下午自己触发，把慢盘打到 io 98.6、读者页 5 秒。
表上放宽 autovacuum 阈值与成本上限，真正的回收交给每天 04:10 的窗口（SKIP_LOCKED、idle I/O）。
取消那次 autovacuum 后 io 从 98.6 掉到 2.76，健康检查回到 0 毫秒。

en.title: Receipts vacuum moves to the small hours
body: receipts: 2.8 GB, 80,000+ dead tuples. An afternoon autovacuum drove the slow disk to io 98.6 and reader pages to 5 s.
Autovacuum thresholds and cost limits are loosened; the real vacuum runs daily at 04:10 (SKIP_LOCKED, idle I/O).
After cancelling that autovacuum, io fell from 98.6 to 2.76 and the health check returned to 0 ms.

releases.title: 钱包空了也别把日志刷穿
body: box 钱包余额为 0 时唤醒会一直回 409，保活进程固定 15 秒重试，日志每 16 秒一条 reconnect。
改成 15→30→60→120→300 秒指数退避，并且只在失败原因变化时打一行。
钱包充值后无需重启，进程会在下一轮自动回到 60 秒一次的正常节奏。

en.title: An empty wallet shouldn't flood the logs
body: With the box wallet at 0, wake kept returning 409; keepalive retried every 15 s and logged a reconnect every 16 s.
It now backs off 15→30→60→120→300 seconds and logs a line only when the failure reason changes.
No restart is needed after a top-up; the process returns to its normal 60-second cadence on the next cycle.

releases.title: 预算测试不再被分钟边界耍
body: 回执并发测试把「本分钟已用次数 + N」当剩余额度，跨分钟边界时 used 归零、剩余变成 used+N，断言随机失败（CI 见过连续三次都放行）。
改成重设到「剩余正好 N」为止，最多三次；再失败会直接报「分钟窗口一直滚动」。
只动测试，不改生产逻辑。

en.title: The budget test stops tripping on minute boundaries
body: The test treated 'used this minute + N' as the remaining quota; CI saw three passes in a row.
At a minute boundary used reset to 0 and the remainder became used + N, so the assertion failed at random.
It resets until the remainder is exactly N, three tries at most; reports 'the minute window keeps rolling'. Test-only.

releases.title: 照文档就能在本地跑起来
body: 干净 clone 实测补了三处：后台起库直接调 node 入口（nohup npm 在 Git Bash 里必挂）、冒烟加了 npm 别名并写明要先构建前端。
迁移条数从 108 改成实际的 114，冒烟地址写明不带 /geohot 前缀。
新增 tests/readme-deploy-docs.test.ts，钉住这些命令不再回退。

en.title: The docs get you running locally
body: Clean clone surfaced three fixes: background DB start calls the node entry directly (nohup npm hangs in Git Bash).
Smoke gains an npm alias and a build-frontend note; migration count goes 108 → 114; smoke URL takes no /geohot prefix.
New tests/readme-deploy-docs.test.ts pins these commands so they cannot regress.

releases.title: 夜里多开一倍的并发
body: 三台执行器都装上昼夜档：白天 0 个分析槽，23:00 起各 2 槽，早上 07:00 收回去。
白天只采集与提正文（实测 540 条/小时，队列已清零），分析留给夜里。
读者面靠边缘缓存与落盘底稿兜着，出现 5xx 时 R115 闸门仍会先保读者。

en.title: Twice the concurrency at night
body: All three executors get a day/night profile: 0 analysis slots by day, 2 each from 23:00, withdrawn at 07:00.
By day they fetch and extract body text only (540 items/hour measured, queue at zero); analysis waits for the night.
The reader side leans on the edge cache and on-disk drafts; on 5xx the R115 gate still protects readers first.

releases.title: 白天也别把正文关掉
body: 昼夜档白天原来写 WORKER_ROLE=fetcher，结果连「正文提取」一起关了：6 小时堆下 420 条只有标题的稿子。
现在白天只关分析（分析槽 0），采集与正文提取照跑；ANALYZE_CONCURRENCY 恒定写 1，写 0 会被当成非法值回落到 6。
夜里仍是 1 个分析槽，读者面优先。

en.title: Don't switch off body extraction by day
body: Day profile used to set WORKER_ROLE=fetcher, which also switched off body extraction; 6 hours, 420 title-only drafts.
Now it turns off analysis only (0 slots); fetching and body extraction keep running, with ANALYZE_CONCURRENCY always 1.
A 0 there is invalid and falls back to 6. Nights still get 1 analysis slot; the reader side comes first.

releases.title: 后台读超时再试一次
body: 真浏览器巡检后台 14 项里有 3 项 503：磁盘抖动一下，/admin/settings 与 /admin/audit 就直接报「稍后再来」。
后台读取现在会在语句超时后自己再试一次，第二次把上限放到 12 秒；两次都超时才回落成原来的提示。
只影响后台读，读者面的预算与并发一个没动。

en.title: Admin reads retry once on timeout
body: Real-browser sweep: 3 of 14 admin checks got 503; one disk hiccup and /admin/settings and /admin/audit said 'try later'.
Admin reads retry once after a statement timeout, at 12 s on the retry; the old message returns only if both time out.
This touches admin reads only; reader-side budgets and concurrency are unchanged.

releases.title: 后台读超时再试一次
body: 真浏览器巡检后台 14 项里有 3 项 503：磁盘抖动一下，/admin/settings 与 /admin/audit 就直接报「稍后再来」。
后台读取现在会在语句超时后自己再试一次，第二次把上限放到 12 秒；两次都超时才回落成原来的提示。
只影响后台读，读者面的预算与并发一个没动。

en.title: Admin reads retry once on timeout
body: Real-browser sweep: 3 of 14 admin checks got 503; one disk hiccup and /admin/settings and /admin/audit said 'try later'.
Admin reads retry once after a statement timeout, at 12 s on the retry; the old message returns only if both time out.
This touches admin reads only; reader-side budgets and concurrency are unchanged.

releases.title: 信源的正式采集目标可以自己调
body: 后台「信源」页多了一个旋钮：正式采集目标从 1000 改成多少，填个原因保存。
它只改政策上限，不动任何一条信源；逐条启停仍在列表里做，两种改动都进审计。
总目标 2000 由迁移定，页面把它和「备用还差多少」一起显示出来。

en.title: The official source target is now adjustable
body: Admin Sources gains a dial: set the official fetch target from 1,000 to whatever you pick, give a reason, save.
It changes only the policy ceiling, not any source; per-source on/off still happens in the list, and both go to audit.
The overall target of 2,000 comes from the migration; the page shows it next to how many spares are still missing.

releases.title: 执行器白天只采集
body: 分析并发会把主库慢盘打到 io 99%，读者面掉到 5–15 秒。
07:00 起执行器只跑采集，23:00 起才开一个分析槽。
两个定时器按北京时间，随仓库安装，可随时改。

en.title: Executors fetch only by day
body: Analysis concurrency drove the primary's slow disk to io 99% and the reader side to 5–15 seconds.
From 07:00 executors fetch only; one analysis slot opens at 23:00.
Both timers run on Beijing time, ship with the repo, and can be changed at any time.

releases.title: 服务器面板按地名认机器
body: 每台机器心跳时带上「地名 + 公网 IP」，后台不再显示实例 id。
杭州 <杭州主机>、武汉 <武汉主机>、华为云广州 <广州边缘主机>、主库 <主库主机>。
老机器没报地名时，退回主机名前缀表。

en.title: The servers panel knows machines by place name
body: Each heartbeat now carries place name + public IP; the admin no longer shows instance ids.
Hangzhou <Hangzhou host>, Wuhan <Wuhan host>, Huawei Cloud Guangzhou <Guangzhou edge host>, primary <primary host>.
When an old machine reports no place name, it falls back to the hostname prefix table.

releases.title: 五台机器，一条流水线
body: Azure 主库管读者面，杭州、武汉、box、广州四台按角色领活，白天收着跑、夜里放开跑，坏了自己回来。

en.title: Five machines, one pipeline
body: The Azure primary serves readers; the four machines in Hangzhou, Wuhan, box and Guangzhou take work by role.
They run restrained by day and open up at night, and come back on their own when they fail.

releases.title: 毫秒级：读者先看到，机器慢慢算
body: 缓存铺到五层，首页与全部每 50 秒保温，国内读者走广州边缘；同一分钟：境外 2.10 秒、国内 0.11 秒、命中 0.0003 秒。

en.title: Milliseconds: readers see it first, machines catch up
body: Cache now runs five layers; home and All are warmed every 50 s, and readers in China go through the Guangzhou edge.
In the same minute: 2.10 s from abroad, 0.11 s in China, 0.0003 s on a hit.

releases.title: 今天的内容，今天就能读到
body: 来源授权、正文、中文文案、相关度、发布门五道全过才上线；补选不再被隐形条件卡住，手机与桌面一直往下拉。

en.title: Today's content, readable today
body: Five gates must all pass: source authorisation, body text, Chinese copy, relevance and the publish gate.
Backfill picks no longer get stuck on invisible conditions.
Mobile and desktop scroll on without end.

releases.title: 国内读者走自己的边缘
body: edge: 华为云广州做国内缓存反代，隧道 8443 回源主库 https，HTML 缓存 120 秒。
warm: 边缘每 50 秒自热六个常用地址，缓存永不过期，实测杭州 0.11 秒、本机 0.29 秒。
exec: 同一台机器兼第二内容执行器（2 槽），与其余四机一起 1,276 条/小时。

en.title: Readers in China get their own edge
body: edge: Huawei Cloud Guangzhou runs the China cache reverse proxy; 8443 tunnel fetches primary https, HTML cached 120 s.
warm: the edge warms six common URLs every 50 s, cache never expires; measured 0.11 s in Hangzhou, 0.29 s locally.
exec: same machine doubles as the second content executor (2 slots); with the other four, 1,276 items/hour.

releases.title: magpie 里能答话的门都进了模型池
body: pool: 补登记 auto 系六扇门与 antigravity/trae-cn/autoclaw 各一扇，实测 1-token 200 才登记。
ops: 三台执行器与本机各补 MAGPIE_BASE_URL，box 与本地隧道新增 3426 转发。
why: 目录 57 个模型里 19 个有门，其余失败的五扇有证据，见 providers/llm.ts 注释。

en.title: Every answering gate in magpie joins the model pool
body: pool: added six auto gates and one each for antigravity, trae-cn, autoclaw; only a 1-token 200 got a gate listed.
ops: added MAGPIE_BASE_URL on three executors and this machine, plus a 3426 forward on box and the local tunnel.
why: of 57 models in the catalog, 19 have a gate; evidence for the five failed gates is in providers/llm.ts comments.

releases.title: 首页每分钟都有人替读者先算一遍
body: web: 首页与「全部」单独一条 60 秒预热带，其余四屏仍 2 分钟。
ops: 预热带走 idle I/O，后台繁忙时也不抢前台的盘。
why: 缓存 60 秒过期，冷算要 2.4–4.2 秒，读者每分钟撞一次。

en.title: Someone precomputes the home page every minute
body: web: home and All get their own 60-second warm band; the other four screens stay at 2 minutes.
ops: the warm band runs at idle I/O and does not take the front end's disk when the system is busy.
why: the cache expires after 60 seconds, a cold compute takes 2.4–4.2 s, and readers hit one every minute.

releases.title: 备份不再抢读者的盘
body: ops: 夜间 pg_dump 改用 ionice idle + nice 19，永远排在读者后面。
ops: receipts 与 receipt_attempts 只导结构，dump 体积与读盘量砍半。
why: 一次全量备份能把主库打到 99%，首页 3.5 秒。

en.title: Backups stop taking the readers' disk
body: ops: the nightly pg_dump now runs under ionice idle + nice 19, always behind readers.
ops: receipts and receipt_attempts are schema-only, halving dump size and disk reads.
why: one full backup could push the primary to 99% and the home page to 3.5 seconds.

releases.title: 部署不再把慢盘算成失败
body: monitor: 验收前先等磁盘安静，等不到就跳过巡检并提示手工复跑。
deploy: 只还原进来时在岗的定时器，不再复活人手工停掉的那几个。
why: 凌晨三次上线被 000/503 判红，还顺手把指纹还原成旧提交。

en.title: Deploys stop counting a slow disk as failure
body: monitor: before acceptance it waits for the disk to settle; if not, it skips the inspection and asks for a manual rerun.
deploy: it restores only the timers that were running on entry, and no longer revives ones a person stopped by hand.
why: three overnight releases were marked red on 000/503, and it also restored the fingerprint to an old commit.

releases.title: 收录池的重算不再挤成一团
body: 一份收录池原来 45 秒就过期，机器跟不上时会自己堆成雪崩
现在五分钟新鲜、半小时可用，现算最多等二十秒
预热器从二十秒一轮改成两分钟一轮

en.title: Pool rebuilds no longer pile up
body: A pool copy expired after 45 seconds, and a machine that couldn't keep up piled rebuilds into an avalanche.
It is now fresh for five minutes and usable for half an hour; an on-demand build waits at most 20 seconds.
The warmer runs every two minutes instead of every 20 seconds.

releases.title: 后台也改成一直往下拉
body: 审计、反馈、信源三个列表滚到底就自动续读
不再有上一页／下一页的按钮，也不用记住页码
取不到时给一次「再试一次」，不做无限重试

en.title: The back office scrolls too
body: The audit, feedback and sources lists load more when you reach the bottom.
No previous/next buttons, and no page numbers to remember.
When a fetch fails there is one “Try again”, not an endless retry.

releases.title: 主题页也改成一直往下拉
body: 主题页原来是每页二十条，读完要按一下「下一页」。
现在滚到底就自动接着取，和精选、全部是同一个手感。
没有脚本的读者仍有分页链接，爬虫照旧能翻。

en.title: Topic pages scroll too
body: Topic pages used to show 20 items per page, with a “Next page” click at the end.
Now they load more at the bottom, the same feel as Picks and All updates.
Readers without scripts still get pagination links, and crawlers can still page through.

releases.title: 订阅源十分钟只算一次
body: 一条订阅源生成要两分钟，期间全站的读都被它挤着。
现在进程内留十分钟，过期先给旧的再后台换新。
并发请求也只在飞一次，不再把慢查询叠起来。

en.title: Feeds are built once every ten minutes
body: Building one feed takes two minutes, and during that time it crowds every other read on the site.
A feed now stays in memory for ten minutes; on expiry the old copy goes out while a new one builds behind.
Concurrent requests share a single build in flight instead of stacking slow queries.

releases.title: 订阅源与报告页单独缓存
body: 一条订阅源要生成两分钟，它把读者读书的位置也占了。
现在它们各走一层十分钟缓存，生成一次全站共用。
顺带把限连接也按回环豁免，部署验收不再自己限死自己。

en.title: Feeds and report pages get their own cache
body: Building one feed takes two minutes and also takes the slot readers need.
Both now sit behind a ten-minute cache, built once and shared across the site.
Connection limits now exempt loopback, so deploy checks no longer throttle themselves.

releases.title: 页面缓存由定时器预热
body: 缓存六十秒一过期，每分钟都有一位读者替全站等冷算。
现在每二十秒由定时器把五个页面算一遍，读者总是命中。
源站实测首屏从三到十五秒降到六到十一毫秒。

en.title: A timer warms the page cache
body: The cache expired every 60 seconds, so once a minute a reader waited out a cold build for the whole site.
A timer now rebuilds five pages every 20 seconds, so readers always hit a warm copy.
Measured on the origin, first paint fell from 3–15 s to 6–11 ms.

releases.title: 重启后首页不用再等数据库
body: 时间线以前只存在内存里，进程一重启就得现算。
主库忙的时候这一屏要十几秒，读者看到的是空白。
现在上一份落盘，重启后读本地文件就能出屏。

en.title: The home page no longer waits on the database after a restart
body: The timeline used to live only in memory, so every restart meant building it from scratch.
With the primary busy, that screen took over ten seconds and readers saw a blank.
The last copy is now on disk; after a restart the local file paints the screen.

releases.title: 首页不再每五秒重算一次
body: 时间线快照只留了五秒，主库一忙就变成一直在冷算。
手机首屏因此在三点五到七点七秒之间打转。
现在留三十秒，仍以下一条精选发布时刻为准。

en.title: The home page no longer rebuilds every five seconds
body: The timeline snapshot lived for five seconds; once the primary was busy, every read was a cold build.
Phone first paint therefore sat between 3.5 and 7.7 seconds.
It now lives for 30 seconds, still timed to the next Pick's publish moment.

releases.title: 补选的精选不再被门挡着
body: 精选巡检补选的条目没写放行时间。
读者门禁当成「未到时间」，一条都不出现。
现在补选即放行，历史 248 条一并补上。

en.title: Backfilled Picks are no longer stuck at the gate
body: Rows added by the Picks check had no release time.
The reader gate read that as “not yet due”, so none of them appeared.
Backfilled rows now go live on selection, and 248 older items were backfilled too.

releases.title: 保活脚本与单元进仓库
body: box 保活进程和它的单元不再是机器上的孤本
部署时连 *.mjs 一起同步到 /opt/geohot/bin
配置漂移从此归零

en.title: Keep-alive script and unit move into the repo
body: The box keep-alive process and its unit are no longer a lone copy living on one machine.
Deploys now sync *.mjs to /opt/geohot/bin as well.
Configuration drift drops to zero.

releases.title: 协调节点不再漏领作业
body: 角色与作业分组写成纯函数，单测钉住
采集、归组、发布、定时不再被漏注册
现场：采集队列涨到 784 条没人领

en.title: The coordinator no longer misses job claims
body: Roles and job grouping are pure functions pinned by unit tests.
Collection, grouping, publishing and scheduling are no longer left unregistered.
The evidence: the collection queue grew to 784 jobs and no one claimed them.

releases.title: 手机不再等收录池
body: 手机切到「全部」时先画出列表的形状，数据到了原地换掉，不再停在一行等待文字上。
每一页成功的收录池答案都落一份到磁盘，重启后第一个读者也直接看到上一份。
主库忙的时候先给这一份，后台再去换新的。

en.title: Phones no longer wait on the pool
body: On a phone, switching to All draws the list shape first and swaps in data as it arrives, instead of a waiting line.
Every successful pool response is written to disk, so the first reader after a restart sees the previous copy.
When the primary is busy, that copy goes out first and a new one is fetched behind.

releases.title: 取图的进程进了仓库
body: 媒体预热原来只在服务器上有一条手写单元，仓库里没有，漂移检查因此永远报一处差异。
现在它有自己的模板：一次只准备一篇、单张图给一分钟、磁盘优先级最低。
想要严格模式就让它跑，想要省磁盘就停掉它，稿件的图会一直停在未就绪。

en.title: The image fetcher moves into the repo
body: Media warm-up was a hand-written unit on the server only; with none in the repo, drift checks always flagged one gap.
It now has its own template: one article at a time, one minute per image, lowest disk priority.
Turn it on for strict mode, off to save disk; the article's images remain not ready.

releases.title: 数条数不再堆成雪崩
body: 「今日几条」「共几条」这两句只是说明文字，却要扫一遍全表，忙的时候一次要几分钟。
现在同时最多两条，每条十五秒就放手，超时就把上一次的数字再写一遍。
读者看到的页面不会因为这两句话而卡住，数字最多旧十分钟。

en.title: Counting no longer avalanches
body: “Today's count” and “total count” are captions, yet each scanned the whole table: minutes apiece on a busy machine.
At most two now run at once, each lets go after 15 seconds, and on timeout the previous numbers are written again.
The page no longer stalls on those two lines, and the numbers are at most ten minutes old.

releases.title: 页面卡住时给上一版
body: 数据库一时跟不上，就让读者看到一分钟前的这一页，而不是一个错误页。
后台照常去取新的一页，取到了下一个人就能看到。
只在出错、超时、正在刷新时使用旧页，正常情况仍然按原样刷新。

en.title: When a page stalls, serve the previous copy
body: When the database can't keep up, readers see this page from a minute ago instead of an error page.
The background still fetches a fresh page, so the next reader sees it.
The old page is used only on error, timeout or a refresh in progress; normal reads still refresh as before.

releases.title: 拒绝的图才跳过
body: 源站自己回 403/404/410 的图跳过它、其余真图照发：这种图谁都取不到，读者打开也是坏的。
超时、连接被掐这类可恢复的失败仍然严格重试，一张都不跳。
取图这一路单独跑在网站那台机器上，慢慢取，不和分析与翻译抢并发。

en.title: Only refused images are skipped
body: Images the origin answers 403/404/410 are skipped; other real images still ship, since nobody could fetch those anyway.
Recoverable failures such as timeouts and dropped connections are still retried strictly, with no image skipped.
The image path runs on its own on the site machine, taking its time and not competing with analysis and translation.

releases.title: 图慢慢取回来
body: 取图超时按机器可调（默认 20 秒）：欧洲机构图站从国内要 28–31 秒，原上限把它们全判成失败。
「取不到的图就摘掉再发布」默认关闭，按严格模式处理：取不到就重试，不拿没图的稿子换读者。
取图单独一路，可以在网站那台机器上单开一个进程慢慢取。

en.title: Images come back slowly
body: Image timeout is per machine (20 s default): European agency image sites need 28–31 s from China, failing the old cap.
“Strip unfetchable images and publish” stays off; strict mode retries rather than ship an article without images.
Images have their own path and can run as a separate process on the site machine, taking their time.

releases.title: 后台不再藏起离线的机器
body: 服务器页现在给每台上报过心跳的机器都留一块：机器掉线时压暗并写明最后一次心跳，而不是只剩表格里一行。
box 也按地名显示，与杭州、武汉一致。

en.title: The back office no longer hides offline machines
body: The servers page keeps a block per machine that sent a heartbeat; offline ones dim and show their last heartbeat.
box is now shown by place name too, in line with Hangzhou and Wuhan.

releases.title: 译文与媒体不再把稿子关在门外
body: 选稿读超时从 2 秒放到 4 秒并在语句超时后重试一次：过去一次超时就让整轮译文作废。
译文一批从 3500 字降到 1800 字、输出上限加倍：模型答复被截断时段数对不上，整批会被丢弃。
正文里的图一张都取不到时，把这几张死图从正文和中文译文里摘掉再判就绪，而不是整篇永远不发。

en.title: Translation and media no longer lock articles out
body: Selection read timeout goes from 2 to 4 s with one retry after a statement timeout; a timeout used to void the round.
Batches drop from 3,500 to 1,800 characters, output limit doubles: truncated replies broke the count and lost the batch.
When no body image can be fetched, the dead ones are removed from the body and Chinese translation before readiness.

lines: 选稿读超时从 2 秒放到 4 秒，并在语句超时后重试一次：过去一次超时就让整轮译文作废。
翻译请求的批量与输出上限保持原样：回执按请求内容记账，改一个字段就要把历史已付的批次重买一次。
正文里的图一张都取不到时，把这几张死图从正文和中文译文里摘掉再判就绪，而不是整篇永远不发。

releases.title: 回执只留一天，采集另开一路
body: 结清的回执正文从留一周改成留一天：账单与成本都在用量列上，正文只在几分钟内重试时有用。
新增 fetcher 角色：一台机器可以只负责出网抓取。杭州到 BBC 等主力源常年超时，交给海外出口去抓。
两处都只是把浪费关掉，不改读者面能看到什么。

en.title: Receipts kept one day; fetching gets its own path
body: Settled receipts keep payloads a day, not a week: billing lives in the usage columns; retries in minutes need the body.
A new fetcher role does outbound only; Hangzhou times out on BBC and main sources, so an overseas egress takes them.
Both changes only turn waste off; neither changes what readers can see.

releases.title: 新稿先上场
body: 扫稿的次序改了：最近一天的稿子按「越新越前」先走，更老的仍从旧到新，补录和回填不会饿死。
先前新稿在待处理里排两小时以上，读者面五个半小时没出现一条新的——不是分析慢，是队伍排错了方向。
改的只是每轮取哪一批，不动优先级，也不多花一次调用。

en.title: New articles take the field first
body: Scan order changed: articles from the last day go newest first, older ones still oldest first, backfill never starves.
New articles waited over two hours; the reader side went five and a half hours with nothing new — wrong queue order.
Only which batch each round takes has changed; priorities are untouched and no extra call is spent.

releases.title: 新稿不再一律等译文
body: 信源没写语言时，正文本身就是证据：抽完正文就地判一次，中文稿当天就能上架。
先前四百四十一篇未就绪里，有四百四十篇只差一份译文——不是内容不好，是没人问过它是什么语言。
译文节拍也从每三分钟八篇提到机器宽裕时每两分钟二十四篇，紧张的机器仍按老节奏走。

en.title: New articles no longer all wait for translation
body: With no language on the source, the body is the evidence: judged after extraction, Chinese articles go up the same day.
Of 441 articles not ready, 440 were missing only a translation — not bad content, just no one had checked its language.
Translation rises from 8 every three minutes to 24 every two minutes when machines have room; tight ones keep the pace.

releases.title: 回执清理改成按编号分段
body: 昨晚的写法每一批都要把整张两万多兆的表扫一遍，机器顶不住。
现在按主键编号分成一万号一段，一段一次提交，读的是索引不是全表。
记账与保留规则没有变，只是同一件事换个不做无用功的做法。

en.title: Receipt cleanup now works in ID ranges
body: Last night's version scanned the whole table — over 20,000 MB — for every batch, and the machine couldn't take it.
It now splits on the primary key into 10,000-ID chunks, one commit each, reading the index rather than the whole table.
Billing and retention rules are unchanged; the same job, done without wasted work.

releases.title: 执行器不再被一次连接超时打死
body: 数据库一时忙不过来时，排队服务会以连接超时抛出，执行器过去会直接退出。
现在它在原地等一等再试，最多八次；停机信号照旧打断所有等待。
机器重启仍然兜底，但当天的重启风暴就是重启自己加重了磁盘压力。

en.title: One connection timeout no longer kills the executor
body: When the database is briefly overloaded, the queue service throws a connection timeout; the executor used to just exit.
It now waits in place and retries, up to eight times; a shutdown signal still interrupts every wait.
Reboots still backstop it, but that day's reboot storm was reboots themselves adding disk pressure.

releases.title: 回执不再把整张表撑到 2.7 GB
body: 每次付费调用的完整请求与响应都在回执里，一周前的正文对记账没有用处。
每日维护现在把结清回执的正文清空，状态、模型、用量与费用全部保留。
失败与未知的回执不动——那两类正是运维要逐条读的。

en.title: Receipts no longer inflate the table to 2.7 GB
body: Each paid call kept its full request and response in the receipt; a week-old payload is useless for billing.
Daily maintenance now clears the payload of settled receipts and keeps status, model, usage and cost.
Failed and unknown receipts are left alone — those are exactly what operations reads line by line.

releases.title: 列表页不再每次都查库
body: 同一页列表 45 秒内直接给缓存，3 分钟内先给旧的再后台刷新。
数据库里那一页要扫两万多行，读者等的是这半秒到一秒。
只改列表接口的读法，筛选、分页与内容口径一字未动。

en.title: List pages no longer hit the database every time
body: The same list page comes from cache for 45 seconds; up to 3 minutes it gets the old copy first, with a refresh behind.
That page scans over 20,000 rows in the database; readers were waiting that half second to a second.
Only how the list API reads has changed; filters, paging and what counts as content are untouched.

releases.title: 管理面板不再白屏
body: Magpie 面板的插件读了一个没定义的全局变量。
我们在页面里先放了一个空壳，插件就能跑起来。
只影响面板渲染，接口与模型调用都没有改动。

en.title: The admin panel no longer goes blank
body: A plugin in the Magpie panel read a global that was never defined.
We put an empty shell in the page first, and the plugin could run.
Only panel rendering was affected; the API and model calls are unchanged.

releases.title: 预算锁拆成八条队
body: 同一个模型的请求不再挤一把锁排队。
锁按请求分开，预算仍按整个服务算。
最坏只多放几条，读者面先顺畅起来。

en.title: The budget lock splits into eight queues
body: Requests for the same model no longer queue on a single lock.
The lock is now per request; the budget is still counted for the whole service.
At worst a few extra requests go through; the reader side gets moving first.

releases.title: 列表页也不空等
body: 「全部」那一屏在后台忙的时候要一秒六，最差和首页一样会报错。
现在它也有上一次成功的那份，十分钟内读不出来就直接给，响应头标明是旧的。
首页与列表走同一条规矩：旧的总比空白强。

en.title: List pages don't wait empty either
body: The All screen took 1.6 seconds when the back end was busy, and at worst errored like the home page.
It now keeps its last successful copy: a failed read within ten minutes gets it, marked stale in a response header.
Home and lists follow one rule: an old copy beats a blank.

releases.title: 读不出来时给上一次的
body: 首页时间线偶尔要等后台两秒多，最差的时候直接空页——读者不该为后台的排队买单。
现在 api 把最近一次成功的首页留十分钟，读不出来就直接给它，并在响应头里标明这是旧的。
没有旧的可给时照旧报错，不把失败说成正常。

en.title: Serve the last good copy when reads fail
body: The home timeline sometimes waits over two seconds and can show an empty page; readers shouldn't pay for the queue.
The API keeps the last good home page for ten minutes and serves it on a failed read, marked stale in a response header.
With no old copy to serve, it still returns an error instead of passing a failure off as success.

releases.title: 排队给读者让路
body: 收据预算锁的排队原来是无限等：一个事务卡住，同 service 的选路与读者查询一起排。
给这次排队加三秒事务级上界，超时按既有的「稍后再来」重试，账本语义不动。
另把信源上限抬到两千——只抬政策，不启用任何一行。

en.title: Queueing gives way to readers
body: Receipt budget lock could wait forever: one stalled transaction blocked routing and reader queries in the same service.
Each transaction now waits at most three seconds; a timeout retries later as before, and the ledger keeps its meaning.
The source cap also rises to 2,000, a policy change only, with no row enabled.

releases.title: 信源体检：五条、三十天
body: 候选订阅不是「能解析」就算数：至少五条，且最新一条在三十天内。
验证读数写进 review_note——条数、最新日期、HTTP 状态；先按 enabled=false 灰度。
审核脚本按发现来源列出候选，--enable 才放行，拒收要写理由。

en.title: Source check: five items, thirty days
body: A candidate feed must do more than parse: at least five items, with the newest one within thirty days.
The check writes its readings to review_note (item count, latest date, HTTP status) and starts with enabled=false.
Review script lists candidates by discovery source; only --enable admits one, and a rejection needs a written reason.

releases.title: 排第一的模型拿不到额度
body: PREFILTER 与 SCORE 的第一位写的是讯飞 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，收据里却一条都没有。
那一行预算还停在每分钟两次，一上来就打满，兜底随即换成别家。
扩到每分钟四十次后，三分钟窗口 45 条、占七成。

en.title: The top-ranked model gets no budget
body: PREFILTER and SCORE both listed iFlytek DeepSeek V4.1 Flash first, yet no receipt came from it.
Its budget line still stood at two calls per minute, so it was used up at once and the fallback switched providers.
Raised to forty calls per minute, it produced 45 receipts in a three-minute window, about 70% of the total.

releases.title: 排在第一的模型拿一半额度
body: 探针位只能让它偶尔被点到一次。实测排在首位的讯飞 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在十分钟里只拿到八十六分之一。
现在池首直接补到与其余成员总量相当的份额，稳定拿到一半；其余成员照旧按健康度分剩下的额度。

en.title: The top-ranked model gets half the budget
body: A probe slot rarely picked it. In a ten-minute test, the top iFlytek DeepSeek V4.1 Flash got just 1/86 of the calls.
The head now gets a share equal to all other members combined, a steady half; the rest split the remainder by health.

releases.title: 池首的模型不再被饿死
body: 智能路由会把配置里排第一的成员静默跳过：它没有失败记录，却一次也拿不到活儿。
现在这种成员保留一个探针位，占一席权重；有失败证据的成员照旧被跳过，不拿钱撞墙。

en.title: The head of the pool is no longer starved
body: Smart routing silently skipped the member listed first in the config: it had no failures, yet never got a call.
Such a member now keeps a probe slot and one unit of weight; failed members are skipped, not funded into a wall.

releases.title: 后台版式收一遍，宽表更宽
body: 后台页头在桌面端吸顶，往下滚长表时标题和操作不消失。
内容诊断、运行、服务器、审计四页改用更宽的版式，表格不再挤成两行。
卡片留白与表格首尾列对齐，长表加斑马纹。

en.title: Admin layout tidied, wide tables wider
body: The admin header now sticks to the top on desktop, so titles and actions stay visible while scrolling a long table.
Content diagnostics, Runtime, Servers and Audit get a wider layout, so table rows no longer squeeze into two lines.
Card padding lines up with the first and last table columns, and long tables gain zebra stripes.

releases.title: 后台的最近入库，可以一直往下拉
body: 内容诊断的「最近入库」过去只给最近 50 条，看到一半就断了。
现在页大小由页面递增着要，滚到底就自动加 60 条，最多到 600 条。
页面加页不发新的历史项，也不会把操作者弹回顶部。

en.title: Recent ingests in admin keep loading
body: The Recent ingests list in Content diagnostics used to stop at the latest 50, cutting off halfway.
The page now asks for growing page sizes, adding 60 items as you scroll, up to 600.
Loading more adds no new history entries and never bounces the operator back to the top.

releases.title: 切到「全部」不该先等一趟网络
body: 手机切精选/全部只换一块列表，收录池却要现场取一次，冷的时候一秒到五秒——那就是截图里的「正在取收录池…」。
手机首屏现在带上「全部」那一份（桌面不付这份钱），切过去直接有内容；取过一次的也留在内存里。
「全部」的月历改回常取：之前它只在 URL 带 tab=all 时才有数据，客户端切换永远画不出来。

en.title: Switching to All shouldn't wait on the network
body: On mobile, Selected/All swaps one list, but the pool was fetched live, 1-5 seconds cold; the screenshot's loading text.
The first screen now carries All too (desktop doesn't pay), so switching is instant; a fetched list stays in memory.
The All calendar is fetched normally again: it had data only with tab=all in the URL, so client switches never drew it.

releases.title: 只放行一次的规矩，把一批回执锁死了八天
body: 模型调用结果未知的回执，系统会自动放行一次；第二次再落成未知，就只能等人工——结果 95 条停在未知状态，最老的卡了八天。
译文与分析的每一轮碰到它们就退回，白跑一趟；译文产能因此一直上不去。
超过一天仍然未知的，再放行一次（笔记与第一次不同，只会多这一次），之后仍归人工。

en.title: A one-release rule locked receipts for eight days
body: Unknown model-call receipts got one automatic release; a second unknown went to a human. 95 stayed, oldest eight days.
Every translation and analysis round bounced off them and wasted a run; translation throughput stayed low.
Still unknown after a day, it gets one more release (a different note, and only this once); after that it is manual.

releases.title: 一分钟一拍，等于每分钟重新数一遍家底
body: 译文任务每分钟触发一次，只有六十秒预算；而「先找候选」要几十次重查询，扫描就把预算花光了，真正翻译的时间几乎没有。
候选扫描缩到最近一千篇、任务改成三分钟一拍、预算一百五十秒，一次能把八篇排进队列。
实测并发放开到六路后，十五分钟译完四篇并全部完成，今天的可读条目从五条涨到八条。

en.title: A one-minute tick meant recounting everything every minute
body: Translation ran each minute on 60 seconds; candidate scans used them on heavy queries, leaving little time to translate.
The scan covers the latest 1,000 items; the task ticks every three minutes with 150 seconds and queues eight a run.
Six-way concurrency finished four pieces in fifteen minutes, all complete; readable items rose from five to eight today.

releases.title: 译文停了十小时，是找候选的活把预算用完了
body: 译文从早上九点四十六分起一条没出：每四分钟的任务都在「先列出全部候选」这一步把时间用完，然后按「本次没活」正常结束。
候选扫描改成只近三十天、最多四千篇，先拿到候选再谈翻译。
实测同一函数立刻译出两篇（2 段与 7 段，全部完成）。

en.title: Translation stalled for ten hours because candidate search used the budget
body: No translation after 09:46: each four-minute task spent its time listing all candidates, then ended as 'no work'.
The candidate scan now covers only the last thirty days, at most 4,000 items, before translation starts.
A test of the same function translated two pieces at once (2 and 7 blocks, both complete).

releases.title: 精选不是发布那一刻的结论
body: 精选一直是发布那一刻定下的：那时还没分析，于是「只准摘要」的条目被选中，而真正可读的全文条目永远不会被重新选中。
新增每十分钟一次的精选重算：全文且已就绪的近期条目补选，非全文的自动选中撤下。
只动从未被裁定过的条目，后台人工调整过的精选不受影响。

en.title: Selection is not a verdict from publish time
body: Selection was fixed at publish time, before analysis ran: summary-only items won, readable full-text items never did.
A recompute every ten minutes selects ready recent full-text items and withdraws auto-selected ones without full text.
It touches only items never adjudicated; selections adjusted by hand in admin are left alone.

releases.title: 两个空白页，都是「没有就当没有」
body: 后台的内容页与运行页一进去是空白：一个把空关键词当成没有内容，一个要等快照生成才肯显示。
内容页改为默认列出最近 50 条；运行页补上常驻的快照生产者，第一次请求就能算出来并落盘。
两处都只动后台的读取路径，读者面不受影响。

en.title: Two blank pages, both treating 'none' as nothing
body: Admin content and Runtime opened blank: one treated an empty keyword as no content, the other waited for a snapshot.
Content lists the latest 50 by default; Runtime got a resident producer, so the first request computes and saves one.
Both change only admin read paths; readers are unaffected.

releases.title: 换个时段的窗口，不该把名额一起换掉
body: 白天十二个名额、夜里两个名额这种写法，本意是让读者优先；实际效果是每天清晨把整台机器的产能砍成四分之一。
现在名额由机器决定，时段只决定什么时候重启。翻译指定的门、调度档位也一并写进仓库脚本，重建机器不会退回旧配置。

en.title: Changing a time window shouldn't change the slots
body: Twelve slots by day and two at night was meant to favor readers; in practice it cut capacity to a quarter each morning.
Slots now belong to the machine, and the time window only sets when it restarts.
The translation gate and scheduling tier now live in the repo script, so a rebuild cannot fall back to old settings.

releases.title: 看不见的文章，也要自己找回来
body: 每篇公开文章都有一行「可以给读者看了吗」的结论；那行被一次改动删掉之后，没有人重新算，它就一直缺着。
读者看到的是空白，日志里看到的是安静。现在每十分钟自动挑最新的缺行文章重算一次，缺多少也会写进日志。

en.title: Invisible articles must find their way back
body: Each public article had a 'can readers see this?' row; one change deleted it, nobody recomputed it, it stayed missing.
Readers saw blank pages and the logs stayed quiet.
Now every ten minutes, the newest articles missing that row are recomputed, and the log records how many are missing.

releases.title: 取不到图，也该再试一次
body: 图片抓取失败一次就放弃的话，那篇文章对读者永远是空的。现在每张图最多试三次。
失败会记下是哪张图、哪个尺寸，不再是查不到出处的一句「1 rendition failure(s)」。

en.title: A failed image fetch deserves another try
body: Giving up after one failed image fetch left that article forever empty. Each image now gets up to three attempts.
A failure records which image and which size, instead of an untraceable '1 rendition failure(s)'.

releases.title: 网络抖一下，不该让一篇稿子等六小时
body: 翻译重试原来三次封顶、一进六小时冷却，网络一抖就把好稿锁住；现在网络类失败只退五分钟，上限放宽到六次。
排期的病根也找到了：那台机器只有一个循环任务名额，翻译几乎每次都被扫描任务挤掉，名额现在给到两个。
读者看到的仍然只有走完整条流水线的条目，这次只是让它们别在半路上被误会。

en.title: A network blip shouldn't park a story for six hours
body: A network blip used to lock a good story: retries capped at three, then a six-hour cooldown.
Network failures now wait five minutes, up to six attempts; the scheduling cause was also found.
One loop slot let scans squeeze translation out; there are two now, and readers still see only fully processed items.

releases.title: 分析队列快了三倍，读者这一侧不受影响
body: 三台机器分工落定：主服务器只负责读者页面，杭州和武汉两台分担内容分析，合计二十个名额。
同一批积压的消化速度从每小时两百多条提到八百条以上，读者首页仍然保持在零点一秒以内。
顺手修了一个沉默很久的问题：有台辅助机的名额一直被系统配置覆盖成两条，改配置文件也不会生效——现在只有一处地方定义名额，改哪一处都看得见。

en.title: Analysis queue three times faster, readers unaffected
body: Three machines have fixed roles: a reader-only main server; Hangzhou and Wuhan share analysis with twenty slots.
The backlog now clears at over 800 items an hour, up from just over 200, while the home page stays under 0.1 second.
Silent problem: config forced a spare machine to two slots and editing it did nothing; slots now have one definition.

releases.title: 定时任务也会卡住，而且卡住的是一小时
body: 每分钟排期信源的那条 cron 认领它的进程一重启，singleton 队列就整整一小时不再跑——今天凌晨它僵了 57 分钟，那一小时没有任何新信源被排期。
过期时间改成按节奏给：分钟级的活 240 秒、五分钟级 300 秒，默认从一小时压到十五分钟。

en.title: Scheduled jobs can stall too, for a whole hour
body: When the process claiming the per-minute source cron restarts, that singleton queue stops for a full hour.
This morning it froze for 57 minutes, and no new sources were scheduled in that hour.
Expiry follows cadence: 240 seconds for minute jobs, 300 for five-minute, default drops from an hour to fifteen minutes.

releases.title: 构建这种活，别让最忙的那台机器干
body: 部署脚本原先在服务器上现跑 vite 构建；891MB 的主库跑到 load 31，首页直接 503，部署超时中断，六个单元一个都没重启。
现在默认带 --web-prebuilt：构建在部署机上完成，只把 build 目录当制品传过去，服务器只负责解包与重启。

en.title: Don't build on the busiest machine
body: The deploy script used to run the vite build on the server: the 891MB box hit load 31 and the home page returned 503.
The deploy timed out and none of the six units restarted.
The default is now --web-prebuilt: build on the deploy machine, ship the build output; the server unpacks and restarts.

releases.title: 标记要问服务器，不能问自己
body: 部署脚本判断「这台机器只做读者面」时，原先在本机找标记文件；在 Windows 上那行直接是命令不存在，过滤被静默跳过，worker 又被拉起来一次。
现在改成先连上服务器问一句，问到才跳过 geohot-worker。

en.title: Ask the server for the marker, not yourself
body: To decide 'this machine serves readers only', the deploy script looked for a marker file locally.
On Windows that line hit a missing command, the filter was skipped silently, and the worker started again.
It now asks the server first and skips geohot-worker only when the answer comes back.

releases.title: 会自己散场的探针
body: 给服务器做体检的那条循环现在自带四小时的寿命上限：到点打印一行 expired 就退出，不再留在后台。
今天线上那台 891 MB 的机器被一条两天前漂出来的旧循环写掉 66 GB 磁盘，读者页一度 503；这次把它收进仓库，也把上限写进测试。

en.title: A probe that packs up on its own
body: The health-check loop now has a four-hour lifetime: it prints one line, expired, and exits instead of lingering.
Today a loop that drifted out two days earlier wrote 66 GB on the 891 MB production box, and reader pages returned 503.
This loop now lives in the repo, and a test pins the lifetime cap.

releases.title: 排队的活，别按超时处理
body: 后台那些必须一个接一个做的步骤（预算判定、同批素材归并）不再被两秒的行锁上限打断：会话级放宽到十五秒，队列真的排下去。
读者那条路保持不变，等不到锁仍然一秒半就走，页面不会因此变慢。

en.title: Queued work shouldn't be treated as a timeout
body: Admin one-at-a-time steps (budget decisions, merging a batch of material) no longer hit a two-second row-lock limit.
The session-level cap is fifteen seconds, so the queue actually proceeds.
The reader path is unchanged: it still gives up after 1.5 seconds without a lock, so pages don't slow down.

releases.title: 读者优先那台机器，先把身份说清楚
body: 主库只做读者面：api 与 web 常驻，抓取和分析交给杭州、武汉两台常驻执行器。
验收与部署现在都认这个身份，不再要求主库跑 worker，也不会每次部署都把它拉起来。

en.title: The reader-first machine states its role
body: Main box serves readers only: api and web stay resident; ingest and analysis go to runners in Hangzhou and Wuhan.
Acceptance and deploy now respect that role: the main box runs no worker, and deploys no longer start one there.

releases.title: 读者和帮手都该看得见
body: 首页与列表的边缘缓存从 1 分钟放到 3–5 分钟，重复打开不必再等一次冷渲染。
服务器面板多了一张「协同节点」：阿里云那两台和本机的心跳都在上面，离线三分钟即标出。

en.title: Readers and helpers should both be visible
body: Edge caching for the home page and lists goes from 1 to 3–5 minutes, so repeat visits no longer wait for a cold render.
The server panel gains a Collaborator nodes card with heartbeats from the two Alibaba Cloud machines and the local box.
A node that stays offline for three minutes is marked down.

releases.title: 换班有了看板，旧结论不再拖住新判断
body: 后台「主题轮换」页能看到每个主题近 30 天的条目、最后一条时间、谁被归档、候选里还排着谁。
健康结论失效之后，正在飞的那次读盘不再被后来者搭车——判死的门立刻生效。

en.title: Topic rotation gets a board; stale verdicts stop blocking new judgments
body: Admin's Topic rotation page shows each topic's last-30-day items, latest item time, archived topics, and the candidates.
Once a health verdict expires, later callers can no longer ride an in-flight read; a gate ruled dead applies at once.

releases.title: 一行被并掉的脚本，等于闸门停摆
body: 编辑时把两行并成一行，闸门每分钟都在 unbound variable 上退出，谁也没发现。
现在有用例钉住那两行的形状——脚本坏了，测试先说。

en.title: One merged line stopped the gate
body: An edit merged two lines into one, the gate exited every minute on an unbound variable, and nobody noticed.
A test now pins the shape of those two lines: if the script breaks, the test speaks first.

releases.title: 放出来的闸门，别被同一批旧账再关回去
body: 早释放说明读者面已经连续健康；窗口里那批 5xx 不该在下一轮把 worker 又冻 30 分钟。
释放时刻之后的新 5xx 照样计数——真正的事故仍有刹车。

en.title: A released gate shouldn't be closed by the same old errors
body: An early release means readers have been healthy; the window's 5xx batch shouldn't freeze the worker another 30 minutes.
New 5xx after the release still count, so a real incident can still hit the brake.

releases.title: 闸门停下的机器，得有人把它拉起来
body: 冷却期里 worker 是闸门自己停的，恢复路径不该把它当成「操作者正在维护」。
切档遇到刹车时不重启进程，观察窗也不再被 90 秒的默认超时腰斩。

en.title: A machine the gate stopped needs someone to restart it
body: The gate itself stopped the worker for the cooldown; recovery should not treat that as operator maintenance.
Tier switches that hit the brake no longer restart the process; the 90-second default no longer cuts the watch window.

releases.title: 归档的主题还能打开，首屏不再许八秒的空白
body: 主题归档后从列表里消失，但它的页面要说“这个主题还在”，不是 404。
首屏预算从八秒收到 3.5 秒：读者等不来内容时，先给上一份好答案。
HTML 与错误页补上 nosniff、Referrer 与禁嵌套；池里那条 deepseek 改成 3426 上真有的 -sg。

en.title: Archived topics still open; no more eight-second blank first screen
body: An archived topic leaves the list, but its page should say 'this topic is still here', not 404.
The first-screen budget drops from 8 seconds to 3.5: if content will not arrive, readers get the last good answer.
HTML and error pages add nosniff, Referrer and frame blocking; the deepseek entry points at the -sg that exists on 3426.

releases.title: 验收自己不该被自己的限速挡住
body: 回环上连取十几个页面，每个页面的 SSR 又各打若干 API，600/min 一下就打满。
回环放行；真实读者仍按每 IP 上限记账。

en.title: Acceptance checks should not be blocked by their own rate limit
body: Fetching a dozen pages over loopback, each SSR calling several APIs, fills the 600/min limit at once.
Loopback is exempt; real readers still count against the per-IP cap.

releases.title: 夜里的算力不该被一次冷探测退回
body: 切档后第一次探测撞上冷页面，4 秒的门槛把整夜退回白天档。
夜间读者很少：页面预算放宽到 8 秒、热身 30 秒，白天仍按 4 秒。

en.title: One cold probe should not send night capacity back
body: The first probe after a tier switch hit a cold page, and the 4-second threshold sent the whole night back to day mode.
Night readers are few: the page budget opens to 8 seconds with a 30-second warm-up; day stays at 4 seconds.

releases.title: 补丁改到了没人下发的文件
body: 强制下发 CSP 的那份 nginx 片段只活在服务器上，仓库里改的是另一份。
现在片段进了仓库，部署会同步它、nginx -t 不过就还原；策略补上 font-src 'self' data:。

en.title: The patch landed in a file nobody deploys
body: The nginx snippet that enforces CSP lived only on the server; the repo changed a different one.
The snippet is now in the repo: deploys sync it, roll back if nginx -t fails. The policy adds font-src 'self' data:.

releases.title: 一批写坏了，不该让整轮停三个小时
body: 主题分配按批写入，连接被服务端收起时整轮抛错，排队守卫以为它还在跑。
现在坏了一批就重写一次，再不行只记数、接着下一批；十分钟后还会再算。

en.title: One bad batch should not stall the whole round for three hours
body: Topic assignment writes in batches; a dropped connection throws the round while the queue guard thinks it is running.
A bad batch is now rewritten once; if that fails, it records the count, moves on, and retries ten minutes later.

releases.title: 机构名有几种写法，分类页就认几种
body: 机构主题以前只认「这家机构是来源」的文章，标签里写着哥白尼、粮农组织的进不来。
现在机构名单独一列，各种写法都算；体裁词仍留给字段与体裁主题。

en.title: Category pages now accept every spelling of an agency name
body: Entity topics used to accept only articles whose source was the agency; those tagged Copernicus or FAO were left out.
Agency names now have their own column, and every spelling counts; genre words stay with fields and genre topics.

releases.title: 六个机构名有了自己的分类页
body: NASA、哥白尼、GDACS、欧空局、自然资源部、粮农组织的文章，之前有一半挂不上主题：标签写法不同，主题只认自己那一个名字。
现在按机构名对齐（欧空局补了新主题），候选表里不该再出现它们。

en.title: Six agency names get their own category pages
body: Half the articles from NASA, Copernicus, GDACS, ESA, the Ministry of Natural Resources and FAO had no topic.
Tag spellings varied, and each topic recognized only one name.
Now they align by agency name (ESA got a new topic), and they should no longer appear in the candidate list.

releases.title: 冷却期不该等于关满十分钟
body: 闸门关掉的是整条流水线：一次冻结十分钟，队列里七千多条一条不动。
读者面已经连续健康时就提前放行，最少也等三分钟再判断，避免抖动。

en.title: A cooldown should not mean a full ten-minute shutdown
body: The gate shut down the whole pipeline: one ten-minute freeze left more than 7,000 queued items untouched.
When the reader side stays healthy it releases early, waiting at least three minutes before deciding, to avoid flapping.

releases.title: 精选只放走完流程的条目
body: 只准摘要的来源、还没走完正文与就绪凭据的条目，不再出现在精选。
空着就空着：那是链路还没追上，不是门该放松。

en.title: Selected admits only items that finished the pipeline
body: Items from summary-only sources, or items still missing body and readiness proof, no longer appear in Selected.
An empty page stays empty: the pipeline has not caught up, and that is no reason to loosen the gate.

releases.title: 爬虫的笛卡尔积，不该由读者的内存来付
body: 历史日期的列表页给一天的缓存：那些内容不会再变。
组合筛选页不再进索引。

en.title: Crawlers' Cartesian products should not cost readers memory
body: List pages for past dates are cached for a day: that content will not change.
Combined filter pages are no longer indexed.

releases.title: 两家机构补上自己的分类页
body: GDACS 与自然资源部此前只有标签、没有主题，180 条与 128 条记录因此无处归类。
现在它们和气象局、USGS 一样有自己的计数与分类页。

en.title: Two more agencies get their own category pages
body: GDACS and the Ministry of Natural Resources had tags but no topic, leaving 180 and 128 records with no category.
They now have their own counts and category pages, like the China Meteorological Administration and USGS.

releases.title: 白天只留一个名额
body: 891MB 的机器上，两个并行分析把公网首页拖到 25 秒 000；收到一个名额，首页回到 1.7 秒。
夜里再放开到两个。

en.title: One slot during the day
body: On an 891MB machine, two parallel analyses took the public homepage to 25 seconds and HTTP 000.
Cutting to one slot brought it back to 1.7 seconds; at night it opens back up to two.

releases.title: 热身中的取数不算故障
body: 部署验收紧跟重启，feed 与 sitemap 是现算的：冷缓存那一下会回转 000，隔 20 秒再取却是 200。
给这两条各三次机会，其余页面仍是一次定生死。

en.title: Warm-up fetches are not failures
body: Deploy checks follow a restart; feed and sitemap are live: a cold cache returns 000, then 200 after 20 seconds.
Those two get three tries each; every other page still lives or dies on one.

releases.title: 候选里不该有杂项与旧人
body: 换班候选第一次跑出十四个词，其中「评论/解读」「非地理/通用」「机构/动态」是体裁不是兴趣点；
「中国气象局」这类名字也早被机构主题认领，只因认领走的是 entity 键才漏算。两处都收口，候选表只留真正无人认领的热词。

en.title: No miscellany or stale names among the candidates
body: The rotation run yielded 14 terms: Comment/Analysis, Non-geographic/General, Agency/Updates are genres, not interests.
Names like China Meteorological Administration were already claimed by entity topics.
They slipped through because claims used the entity key; both leaks are closed, and only unclaimed hot terms remain.

releases.title: 计数不该读整张表
body: 同一屏的「找到 N 条」要数一遍公开条目，而公开条目有十万行、正文列很大：冷缓存下一次要 17–20 秒。
补了三个只带 article_id 的窄局部索引，计数改走 index-only；同一条 SQL 现在 120 毫秒。

en.title: Counting should not scan the whole table
body: The “N results found” line counted public items: 100,000 rows with a large body column took 17–20 seconds cold.
Three narrow partial indexes on article_id alone let the count go index-only; the same SQL now takes 120 milliseconds.

releases.title: 半径算成了负数
body: 日报的网点图在入场动画里用缓动函数算半径，浮点误差能让它落到 -3.5e-16，画布直接抛 IndexSizeError。
真浏览器在 /daily 抓到这条报错。半径现在按 0 兜底，两处画布都改了。

en.title: The radius came out negative
body: The daily dot graphic computes radius with an easing function; floating-point error can push it to -3.5e-16.
The canvas then throws IndexSizeError. A real browser caught it on /daily; radius now falls back to 0 in both canvases.

releases.title: 失效之后，别把旧结论写回缓存
body: 模型健康结论缓存一分钟。若失效恰好发生在一次读盘在飞时，那次读盘会把「失效前」的结论写回缓存，紧接着的请求就用了过时的健康判断。
现在读盘认代数：失效之后回来的结果直接丢弃。CI 上偶发的一条池子用例正是撞在这个时序上。

en.title: After expiry, do not write the old verdict back to cache
body: The model health verdict is cached for one minute; if expiry lands mid-read, the read writes the old verdict back.
The next request then uses a stale judgement. Disk reads now check the generation and discard results that return late.
A flaky pool test on CI was hitting exactly this timing.

releases.title: 精选空白，是因为门只认全文
body: 今天被选中的 8 条里，有 7 条来自本来就不提供全文的来源，全被「要有全文就绪凭据」这道门挡在外面。
现在摘要条目只要来源确实不给全文、摘要有内容，就能进精选；能取全文的来源退化成摘要仍然要等就绪。

en.title: Selected was blank because the gate only accepted full text
body: Of the 8 items selected today, 7 came from sources that never provide full text; the readiness-proof gate kept them out.
Summary items now enter Selected when the source truly withholds full text and the summary has content.
Sources that can provide full text still wait for readiness if they fall back to a summary.

releases.title: 主题该定期换班
body: 主题栏里挂着一个月没有新条目的板块，读者点进去只看到去年的稿子——这不是内容少，是我们没让它换班。

en.title: Topics need to rotate on a schedule
body: The topic rail carried a section with no new items for a month; readers who clicked found last year's stories.
That was not a lack of content; we had failed to rotate it.

releases.title: 判精选的那条链路，该有自己的一条车道
body: 线上读到的事实：24 小时里分析链路新进 1,497 条、只跑完 362 条，而同一时间全流水线跑完了 9,142 条。

en.title: The Selected verdict needs a lane of its own
body: In production, the analysis lane took in 1,497 items in 24 hours and finished 362, while the pipeline finished 9,142.

releases.title: 尾页正好装满的时候，下一页不该是一张空表
body: 后台的「下一页」原来靠“这一页满 100 条”来猜还有没有下一页。
尾页正好装满时，按钮还在，点进去是一张空表：操作者会以为记录丢了，其实是自己翻过头了。

en.title: A full last page should not lead to an empty next page
body: The admin's Next page button used to guess whether another page existed from whether this page held 100 rows.
A full last page kept the button; clicking it opened an empty table, so operators thought records were lost.

releases.title: 部署自己写的窗口
body: 闸门的部署窗口是两个 epoch 两行，而它只读第一行——结束时间从来没被看见，部署之后二十分钟内的 5xx 全被当成自家重启排掉。
现在按行读。

en.title: The deploy wrote its own window
body: The gate's deploy window was two epochs on two lines, but it read only the first; the end time was never seen.
Every 5xx in the twenty minutes after a deploy was dismissed as our own restart. It now reads every line.

releases.title: 审计与它记录的那笔写入，不该是两件事
body: 换模型、删反馈、回复读者、导入评测、调整预算：审计行和真正的写入现在在同一个事务里。

en.title: The audit and the write it records should be one thing
body: Model switches, feedback deletes, reader replies, evaluation imports and budget changes now share one transaction.
The audit row and the actual write are no longer two separate things.

releases.title: 标签行不是稿子，审计列表也不该裸着查
body: 摘要只写着 summary_zh： 这种东西，以前能进列表、RSS、搜索和站点地图，点进去却是 404。

en.title: Tag rows are not articles, and the audit list should not read raw rows
body: Rows whose summary was just “summary_zh: …” reached lists, RSS, search and the sitemap, then returned 404 when clicked.

releases.title: 判「精选」的那条链路不该排在便宜活后面
body: 分析链路 24 小时新进 1496 条、只跑完 493 条，而同一段时间里整条流水线完成了 9142 条 —— 名额被抓取探测、摘要、配图这些几秒钟的活占满

en.title: The Selected lane should not queue behind cheap work
body: In 24 hours the analysis lane took in 1496 items and finished 493, while the whole pipeline completed 9142.
Its slots were filled by crawl probes, summaries and artwork, jobs that take seconds.

releases.title: 真实浏览器把这些话说出来了
body: 这轮第一次用真实 Edge（`--headless=old` + CDP）打开线上站点逐页操作，页面本身是好的，但浏览器控制台在说话 —— 两件事都修了。

en.title: A real browser said it out loud
body: This round used real Edge (`--headless=old` + CDP) to open the live site and walk every page for the first time.
The pages themselves were fine, but the browser console had things to say; both were fixed.

releases.title: 每一条边界问的都是同一件事
body: 这轮修的是「数据脏了或时钟不准时，页面向读者说了什么」，五处。

en.title: Every edge case asks the same question
body: This round fixed what pages tell readers when data is dirty or clocks are off: five places.

releases.title: 同一个故事被两个方向同时合并时
body: 这一轮都是「并发或参数写错时会发生什么」，共八处，读者面与后台都沾一点。

en.title: When one story is merged from both directions at once
body: This round covered what happens under concurrency or a bad parameter: eight places, touching the reader side and admin.

releases.title: 停机之后不该再开队
body: 这一轮改的是「出错时会发生什么」，读者看不见，但决定后台还能不能自己爬起来。

en.title: After a stop, the queue should not reopen
body: This round changed what happens on errors. Readers will not see it, but it decides whether the backend can get back up.

releases.title: 签名过期、还没出刊、名单装满——三处边界
body: 这一轮改的都是「只在边界上出现」的小毛病，平时看不见，撞上了就是一个坏答案。

en.title: Expired signatures, unpublished issues, a full roster: three edges
body: Three small faults that appear only at the edges. You never see them normally; when you hit one, you get a wrong answer.

releases.title: 一条已经断掉的数据库连接
body: 凌晨两点零九分，后台任务进程直接退出重启了一次。

en.title: A database connection that had already dropped
body: At 2:09 a.m., the background job process exited and restarted once.

releases.title: 后台页面不再因为一分钟的忙被当成坏了
body: 凌晨一点十七分，机器正在跑一批分析任务，`/admin/sources` 打开后是一句「后台读取暂时超时」。

en.title: Admin pages no longer look broken after a minute of load
body: At 1:17 a.m., with a batch of analysis jobs running, `/admin/sources` opened to one line: “backend read timed out.”

releases.title: 每天看一眼：哪个主题没跟上最近的新闻
body: 站点有 43 个主题，其中有几个只靠一两条信源。

en.title: A daily look: which topics have not kept up with the news
body: The site has 43 topics, and a few of them rest on only one or two sources.

releases.title: 同一条内容，两个出口不再给出相反的答案
body: 这一批修的是「同一件事在两个地方说法不一样」：日报索引说能读、点进去是 404；条目页说没有正文、`.md` 却照发一份；手机上收起的内容，把窗口拉宽之后再

en.title: One item, two exits: no more opposite answers
body: This batch fixes two-answer bugs: the daily index says an item is readable, but clicking it gives a 404.
Its page says there is no body, yet the `.md` is still served; collapsed mobile content, after the window is widened …

releases.title: 夜里多干活，但不再拿阅读页面去换
body: 站点的信息流水线在凌晨会拿到更多资源，好把积压消化得快一些。

en.title: More work at night, without trading away the reading page
body: The site's information pipeline gets more resources overnight, so the backlog clears faster.

releases.title: 订阅源不再被一条坏数据卡住
body: 一处坏数据不再让订阅源整段停更：以前只要有一条记录的放行时间被写成很远的将来，订阅源的水位就会永久停在它前面，后面所有新内容都出不去。

en.title: A feed is no longer stuck on one bad record
body: One bad record no longer stalls a feed: a far-future release time froze the watermark and blocked every new item.

releases.title: 手机上精选和全部合成一屏
body: 手机上「精选」和「全部」不再是两个页面：点一下，列表当场换，地址栏只多出一个 `?tab=all`，转发出去的链接还落在同一段。

en.title: On mobile, Selected and All share one screen
body: Selected and All are one screen: a tap swaps the list, the URL only adds `?tab=all`, and shared links still land there.

releases.title: 主题计数的一处更正
body: 11 月 3 日那条写的是「全部 43 个主题都有真实条目支撑」，实测是 42/43。

en.title: A correction to the topic count
body: The November 3 entry said all 43 topics had real items behind them. The measured figure is 42 of 43.

releases.title: 页脚清洗的判据只剩一份
body: 抽取、入库、喂模型、中文兜底四处共读 `lib/text.ts` 里的同一套规则；两个清洗脚本不再各自手抄一份正则。

en.title: One copy of the footer-cleaning rules
body: Extraction, ingest, model input and Chinese fallback all read one set of rules in `lib/text.ts`.
The two cleanup scripts no longer keep hand-copied regexes.

releases.title: worker 反复重启时
body: 原判据是「本轮结算过才告警」，于是一个活不过二十分钟、反复重启的 worker 会让内容告警一直不出声。

en.title: When a worker keeps restarting
body: The old rule fired only after a round settled, so a worker dying inside twenty minutes silenced content alerts.

releases.title: 后台读取卡住时给一句话
body: 后台的内容、信源、模型、用量、反馈几个读取页都挂上了数据库侧的语句超时（5 秒，只读事务）。

en.title: One line when an admin read hangs
body: Admin reads for content, sources, models, usage and feedback now have a database statement timeout.
It is 5 seconds, and these are read-only transactions.

releases.title: 主题页换上真正有内容的主题
body: 「中东与北非干旱区」「东部沿海城市群」两个区域主题自上线起就没有匹配到一条内容（词表产不出只属于这两个区域的标签写法，一直空着）。

en.title: Topic pages now use topics with actual content
body: Two regional topics had no content since launch: Middle East and North Africa Drylands, Eastern Coastal City Clusters.
The vocabulary could not produce tags unique to these regions, so both pages stayed empty.

releases.title: 隐私说明对齐实际行为
body: 隐私说明更新到与站内实际行为逐条一致，补上了此前没写全的截图、备份与服务器日志三类事实。

en.title: Privacy notice aligned with actual behavior
body: The privacy notice now matches actual behavior and adds three missing facts: screenshots, backups and server logs.

releases.title: 全站例行体检
body: 本轮全站体检修掉了 11 处读者可能撞上的小问题，多数平时看不见，撞上时却很奇怪。

en.title: Routine site-wide checkup
body: This round fixed 11 small problems readers could hit. Most stay invisible; when you hit one, it feels odd.

releases.title: 新内容恢复及时上站
body: 后台排队攒了几千条历史文章待处理时，新到的文章会被排队的旧任务成批插到前面，读者看到的最新内容一度落后约 40 小时。

en.title: New content reaches the site on time again
body: With thousands of old articles queued, old jobs jumped ahead of new ones; the newest content once lagged about 40 hours.

releases.title: 从读到回信：站点有了完整的读者服务闭环
body: 2.0 把地理消息串成了读得懂的线索；这一个月，我们把「读」延伸成「能对话」——你提交的每条反馈都直达站长邮箱，处理进度随时可查，答复直接回进你的邮箱。

en.title: From reading to replies: a complete reader-service loop
body: Version 2.0 turned geographic news into threads you can follow.
This month we extended reading into conversation: every feedback reaches the site owner's inbox.
You can check its status at any time, and replies come straight back to your inbox.

releases.title: 全站联系渠道统一为邮箱
body: 全站检查并移除了旧协作工具（飞书）的最后一处读者可见痕迹：介绍页「成刊」一段改为 RSS、API、MCP 订阅口径。

en.title: All site contact channels now use email
body: The site removed the last reader-visible trace of its old collaboration tool (Feishu).
The intro page's Publish section now describes RSS, API and MCP subscriptions.

releases.title: 正文抽取更稳更快
body: 后台抽取正文时，每一步都留下可查的日志，出了问题能立刻找到原因。
- 抽取支持多路并行，队列消化更快。
- 服务器吃紧时辅助自动让路，读者页面不受影响。

en.title: Body extraction is steadier and faster
body: Every extraction step in the backend now leaves a searchable log, so a failure can be traced at once.
- Extraction runs in parallel lanes, so the queue drains faster.
- Under server pressure the auxiliary work yields automatically; reader pages are unaffected.

releases.title: 日报条目全部可读
body: 日报里「来源仅准摘要」的条目，点击标题不再落空。
- 现在会打开一个受限页：标题、导读、来源与原文入口都在，站内全文按来源许可提供。

en.title: Every daily entry can be read
body: For daily items whose source allows only a summary, clicking the title no longer leads nowhere.
- They open a restricted page with title, summary, source and original link; full text follows the source license.

releases.title: 日报条目跳转修正
body: 上一版部分条目点击后落了 404，这一版把每个标题都指到真正存在的页面。
- 期刊条目的排版也向文章页看齐，标题与摘要的字号行距一致。

en.title: Daily entry links fixed
body: In the last version some entries landed on a 404; every title now points to a page that actually exists.
- Journal entries now match article pages: same font size and line spacing for titles and summaries.

releases.title: 日报标题全部可点
body: 日报、周报、月报里此前不可点的标题，现在都能点了。
- 有站内页的跳站内页，没有的跳原文；仅来源撤回的保持纯文本。

en.title: All daily headlines are clickable
body: Titles in the daily, weekly and monthly reports that could not be clicked now can be.
- Those with a page on the site open it; others open the original; source-retracted items stay plain text.

releases.title: 反馈页更好用
body: 「查询处理状态」默认展开，编号、邮箱、查询按钮一屏可见。
- 正文输入区收紧，提交按钮不用再滚动找。

en.title: A more usable feedback page
