body: “Check status” is open by default: ticket number, email and the check button fit on one screen.
- The message box is tighter, so the submit button no longer needs scrolling.

releases.title: 期刊图片不再裁切
body: 期刊配图的查看器初始放大有了上限，图片上下不再被裁掉一截。

en.title: Journal images are no longer cropped
body: The viewer for journal images now caps its initial zoom, so the top and bottom are no longer cut off.

releases.title: 期刊图片默认看得更全
body: 期刊图片打开时默认放大到满宽，和文章页的观感一致。

en.title: Journal images show more by default
body: Journal images now open zoomed to full width by default, matching the article page.

releases.title: 反馈可查进度，推送链精简
body: 反馈页新增「查询处理状态」：留了邮箱的反馈，处理后能收到回信。
- 转发邮件带上你的回复地址，直接回信就能到达。
- 撤下了从未启用的旧推送链路，站点更轻。

en.title: Feedback status, with a slimmer push chain
body: The feedback page adds “Check status”: if you leave an email, you get a reply once your feedback is handled.
- Forwarded mail now carries your reply address, so replying reaches you directly.
- We removed an old push chain that was never enabled, making the site lighter.

releases.title: 日报图片支持缩放查看
body: 日报、周报、月报里的图片接上了全功能查看器：点开可放大、拖动、双指缩放。

en.title: Report images support zoom and pan
body: Images in the daily, weekly and monthly reports now open in the full viewer: zoom, pan and pinch-to-zoom.

releases.title: 反馈回复直达邮箱
body: 后台可以直接回复读者了，回信从站长邮箱发出。
- 删除反馈改为整条消失，不留残余。

en.title: Feedback replies go straight to email
body: The admin can now reply to readers directly, with replies sent from the site owner's inbox.
- Deleting feedback now removes the whole record, leaving nothing behind.

releases.title: 反馈提交更有仪式感
body: 反馈提交成功后是一整屏的居中庆祝卡，不再是一行小字。

en.title: Feedback submission gets a full-screen celebration
body: After a feedback submission, a centered celebration card fills the screen instead of a single line of small text.

releases.title: 后台反馈管理更好用
body: 后台能看到反馈来源的所在地，方便识别重复与滥用。
- 删除反馈不再需要填原因，少一步。

en.title: Feedback admin shows where each report came from
body: The admin panel now shows the location behind each feedback item, so duplicates and abuse are easier to spot.
- Deleting feedback no longer asks for a reason, one step less.

releases.title: 反馈统一走邮箱
body: 反馈转发收束为邮箱直发这一条通道，旧渠道的入口与残留全部移除。
- 全站不再出现旧协作工具的痕迹。

en.title: Feedback now goes through email only
body: Feedback forwarding now has one channel: direct email. The old channel's entry points and leftovers are removed.
- No trace of the old collaboration tool is left anywhere on the site.

releases.title: 反馈直达站长邮箱
body: 每一条反馈连同截图，实时投进站长的 QQ 邮箱。
- 失败自动重试一周，不丢反馈。

en.title: Feedback reaches the site owner's QQ mailbox
body: Every feedback item, screenshots included, goes straight to the site owner's QQ mailbox in real time.
- Failed sends retry automatically for a week, so feedback is not lost.

releases.title: 后台「通知目的地」板块下线
body: 后台设置页的通知目的地列表（飞书内容主群/镜像群的启用开关与投递统计）整块移除：站内没有飞书，两条目的地从未启用、内容推送阀关闭、7 天投递为 0，启用入口

en.title: Admin notification destinations section removed
body: The notification destinations list in admin settings is removed: Feishu main/mirror group switches and delivery stats.
No Feishu here: neither destination was ever enabled, the content push valve is closed, 7-day deliveries are 0.
The enable entry...

releases.title: 联系方式换真邮箱
body: 安全联系邮箱填入真实 QQ 邮箱，security.txt、llms.txt 与后台回复提示随之自动更新；关于页的公众号与飞书群二维码上传入口整块下线——页

en.title: Contact email switched to the real mailbox
body: The security contact now uses a real QQ mailbox, and security.txt, llms.txt and the admin reply hint update with it.
The upload entries for the About page's WeChat account and Feishu group QR codes are gone too: the page...

releases.title: 官方价核对跑通
body: 首轮自动核对照出三处脚本自身问题并逐一修掉：解析结果键名归一（单条与组合正则各按其键返回）、汇率刷新子进程不再被连接池挂住、写库值全部走参数绑定。

en.title: Official price check runs end to end
body: The first automatic check found three bugs in the script, all fixed.
Result keys are normalized: single and bundled regexes each return by their own key.
The exchange-rate refresh child process no longer hangs on the connection pool; database writes use parameter binding.

releases.title: 每日闲时官方价核对上线
body: 新开一条 05:50（北京时间，随机五分钟）的闲时核对：把九条模型官方价（DeepSeek、腾讯混元、智谱双版、Step、MiniMax、Dots、Agne

en.title: Daily off-peak official price check goes live
body: A new off-peak check runs at 05:50 Beijing time, inside a random five-minute window.
Nine models' official prices: DeepSeek, Tencent Hunyuan, Zhipu (two versions), Step, MiniMax, Dots, Agne...

releases.title: 恢复 MiniMax 全球门并接入六账号
body: 把本机重新登录的六个 MiniMax Code（Global）账号凭据同步到服务器网关，恢复该门可用，并把这一扇以六账号轮询的额度接回模型池各步骤；同步保留

en.title: MiniMax global gate restored with six accounts
body: Credentials for six re-logged-in MiniMax Code (Global) accounts went to the server gateway, restoring the gate.
Its quota now rotates across the six accounts and feeds model-pool steps again; the sync keeps...

releases.title: 模型池扩容：注册 14 扇 magpie
body: 本机 magpie 同步把服务器网关扩到 66 个模型，其中 14 扇核验过的门（qwenwork、antigravity、trae-cn、qoder、lo

en.title: Model pool grows by 14 magpie gates
body: A local magpie sync took the server gateway to 66 models, 14 of them verified gates.
The verified gates include qwenwork, antigravity, trae-cn, qoder, lo...

releases.title: 本机辅助支持维护互斥与登录后有限协同
body: 补充服务器端独占维护登记和普通用户计划任务工具。
资源与版本检查通过后，本机可用单槽分担公开网页正文抽取；每轮限时运行，离线不影响服务器完整工作流。

en.title: Local helper gets a maintenance lock and limited work after login
body: Added an exclusive maintenance registration on the server side and scheduled-task tools for regular users.
After resource and version checks pass, the local machine can share public web body extraction on a single slot.
Each run is time-boxed, and going offline does not affect the server's full workflow.

releases.title: 额度耗尽后立即避开对应模型成员
body: 模型明确返回额度耗尽或认证拒绝时，后续分段任务立即采用池内其他有效成员，不再等待一分钟健康缓存刷新。

en.title: Skip exhausted model members at once
body: If a model reports an exhausted quota or an auth rejection, later segments use another valid pool member at once.
They no longer wait a minute for the health cache to refresh.

releases.title: 补充受控的本机正文抽取辅助能力
body: 增加仅处理公开网页正文的单槽辅助角色，保留服务器独立工作流。
辅助抽取失败时交回服务器继续兜底，不提前分析或发布；电源、资源、版本和维护条件不符时停止新领取。

en.title: Controlled local helper for body extraction
body: Added a single-slot helper that handles only public web body text, while the server keeps its own workflow.
If the helper fails, the server takes the job back and finishes it, with no early analysis or publishing.
It stops claiming new work when power, resources, version or maintenance conditions do not fit.

releases.title: 统一运行源码并恢复结果未知回执的专门处理
body: 将服务器实际使用的资源调度、用量日历与标准费用口径、长文分析预算及图片恢复逻辑补齐至仓库。

en.title: Runtime source unified; unknown-result receipts get their own path
body: The repo now matches what the server actually runs: resource scheduling, the usage calendar and standard cost basis.
Long-form analysis budget and image recovery logic are included too.

releases.title: 现有精选与动态页面支持静默更新
body: 精选、全部动态首页、热点榜和主题首页在前台停留顶部时每分钟读取已完成工作流的最新公开内容，保持现有入口和布局。

en.title: Selected and feed pages refresh silently
body: Selected, the All feed home, the hot list and the topics home refresh once a minute while the tab stays at the top.
They pull the latest public content from finished workflows, keeping the current entry points and layout.

releases.title: 补齐模型配置版本与小浣熊免费模型注册
body: 回收已在线使用的 CodeArts-1017、Qoder 国际版和 MiniMax 模型注册配置；新增小浣熊三个免费模型，采用最高思考参数并声明已验证的图片

en.title: Model config versions filled in; Xiaohuanxiong free models registered
body: Retired the registration configs for CodeArts-1017, Qoder International and MiniMax that were already in online use.
Added three free Xiaohuanxiong models, with the highest thinking parameters and declared verified images...

releases.title: 报刊引用状态与历史内容修复
body: 日报、周报、月报组稿共用完整工作流门禁，区分来源撤回、全文限制和材料待核验。

en.title: Report citation status and historical content fixed
body: Daily, weekly and monthly reports now share the full workflow gate.
It separates source retractions, full-text limits and material still under verification.

releases.title: 精简图片查看器提示
body: 移除图片查看器底部的操作提示，保留缩放按钮、拖动和手势功能。

en.title: Image viewer hints trimmed
body: Removed the operation hint at the bottom of the image viewer; zoom buttons, dragging and gestures stay.

releases.title: 图片细节缩放、移动阅读与历史期刊恢复
body: 图片查看器增加放大、缩小、适应窗口、原始尺寸和拖动，支持双击、双指与键盘，切图后重置视图。

en.title: Image zoom, mobile reading and historical issues recovered
body: The image viewer gains zoom in, zoom out, fit to window, original size and drag.
Double-click, two fingers and the keyboard work, and the view resets when you switch images.

releases.title: 补强源正文完整性核验与论文提取
body: 拦截明确截断摘要和仅含参考文献的论文正文。

en.title: Stronger source body completeness checks and paper extraction
body: Blocks abstracts that are clearly truncated and paper bodies that contain only references.

releases.title: 完整工作流通过后再公开文章
body: 取消仅摘要来源和摘要模式的文章放行例外。
当前版本分析、完整正文、适用完整译文及正文媒体就绪后才提供阅读页，旧放行结果按新规则有界复核。

en.title: Articles go public only after the full workflow passes
body: Removed the exception that let abstract-only sources and abstract-mode articles go public.
A reading page now waits for current-version analysis, full body, applicable full translation and body media.
Earlier releases are rechecked under the new rule within bounds.

releases.title: 开源仓库流程图支持查看高清 PNG
body: 中英文说明中的架构流程图改用 3600 像素宽的 PNG，点击后直接打开图片，可按原尺寸放大阅读。

en.title: Repo flow diagrams open as high-resolution PNGs
body: Architecture diagrams in the Chinese and English READMEs are now 3600 px wide PNGs that open directly at full size.

releases.title: 在现有服务器上兼顾新内容与历史待办
body: 调整后台任务分配，让新内容继续优先处理，同时为较早的待办保留执行机会；没有扩容服务器或提高总体并发。

en.title: New content and old backlog share the existing server
body: Background job allocation is rebalanced: new content still goes first, and older backlog keeps a chance to run.
No servers were added and overall concurrency did not rise.

releases.title: 用量总览增加日历
body: 用量总览新增按北京时间选日的月历，可查看某一天的请求、Token、模型与任务用量，并继续使用服务和模型筛选。

en.title: Calendar added to usage overview
body: The usage overview now has a monthly calendar for picking a day in Beijing time.
It shows that day's requests, tokens, models and tasks, with the service and model filters still in place.

releases.title: 网站工作流同步 CodeArts Dee
body: 将网站 CodeArts 通道的实际模型同步到 Magpie 中已选用的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017，保留既有最高思考强度设置。

en.title: Site workflow syncs CodeArts Dee
body: The site's CodeArts channel now runs the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 model already selected in Magpie.
The existing highest thinking setting stays.

releases.title: 内容通过完整性校验后再公开
body: 公开阅读入口按当前版本的原文、译文和必要媒体检查就绪状态，避免把尚未完成处理的内容作为完整文章呈现；就绪后再由正常工作流恢复公开。

en.title: Content goes public after completeness checks
body: Public reading entries now check that the current version's original text, translation and required media are ready.
Unfinished content is no longer shown as a complete article; once ready, the normal workflow restores publication.

releases.title: 识别正文节选
body: 改善 RSS 节选识别与正文提取，修复已确认的部分期刊、Mongabay 和 DW 图片地址问题，并将确认缺失的历史正文交回正常工作流重提取。

en.title: Body excerpts are now detected
body: Improved RSS excerpt detection and body extraction.
Fixed confirmed image URL problems at some journals, Mongabay and DW.
Historical bodies confirmed missing go back to the normal workflow for re-extraction.

releases.title: 修复用量总览长期停留在旧统计的问题
body: 今天、7 天、30 天、90 天和全部范围改为协调更新统计快照，修复各范围长期停留在不同旧时间的问题。

en.title: Usage overview no longer sticks to old stats
body: Today, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days and All now refresh their stats snapshots together.
This fixes ranges that had long sat on different old times.

releases.title: 改善现有低内存服务器的后台调度与恢复
body: 减少重复常驻进程和后台争抢，完善资源压力下的退让、正常停机与自动恢复，让网页访问与内容处理共享现有服务器资源。

en.title: Better background scheduling and recovery on the low-memory server
body: Fewer duplicate resident processes and less background contention.
Added better yielding under resource pressure, graceful shutdown and automatic recovery.
Web requests and content processing share the existing server.

releases.title: 把世界的地理变化，串成每天读得懂的线索
body: 从地理信源到中文阅读、事件追踪和日报，回顾 GEOHOT 建站以来的主要变化。

en.title: Turning the world's geographic change into threads you can read each day
body: From geographic sources to Chinese reading, events and the daily brief: the main changes since GEOHOT launched.

releases.title: 后台加载更轻，更新日志更好读
body: 后台统计分开读取，避免一次慢查询拖住整个页面。
- 更新日志改用简短说明，保留每次更新的日期和主要变化。

en.title: Lighter back office, clearer changelog
body: Back-office stats now load separately, so one slow query no longer stalls the whole page.
- Changelog entries now use short notes, keeping each release's date and main changes.

releases.title: 恢复页面访问，改善长文翻译
body: 修复后台处理繁忙时页面难以打开的问题，改善公开页面的访问稳定性。
- 完善长文分段翻译，补充对官方公报正文的支持，并更新安全防护。

en.title: Page access restored, long-form translation improved
body: Fixed pages that were hard to open while the back office was busy, improving stability on public pages.
- Improved chunked translation for long articles, added official bulletin support and updated security protections.

releases.title: 加快历史内容整理，恢复站点访问
body: 修复历史内容处理停滞的问题，减少待整理与待翻译条目。
- 补充微信公众号全文和新闻搜索来源，并恢复部分被误停的信源。

en.title: Faster archive processing, site access restored
body: Fixed stalled processing of historical content, reducing the items waiting to be organised and translated.
- Added full-text WeChat official account sources and news search sources; sources stopped by mistake were restored.

releases.title: 继续补充历史资讯与译文
body: 优先整理历史条目，进一步减少待办，并持续补充中文译文。
- 本轮曾暂停实时采集约 8.6 小时，恢复后已抓回部分暂停期间发布的内容。

en.title: More historical items and Chinese translations
body: Prioritised historical items, further cut the backlog and kept adding Chinese translations.
- Live collection paused for about 8.6 hours; after resuming, some content published during the pause was collected.

releases.title: 四期历史日报补入更多内容
body: 按新闻日期整理历史资料，四期历史日报补入更多要闻，旧版仍可查阅。
- 调整译文处理顺序，兼顾新内容与较短正文。

en.title: Four backfilled daily briefs gain more top stories
body: Four backfilled daily briefs gained more stories after material was sorted by news date; old versions remain readable.
- Translation work was reordered to cover both new content and shorter articles.

releases.title: 英文条目开始提供中文正文
body: 为精选英文全文条目补充中文译文，已生成 244 篇，其中 227 篇完整。
- 改善分段翻译，拦截把长文缩成摘要的结果，并清除混入正文的网页杂项。

en.title: Chinese text now available for English items
body: Added Chinese translations to selected English full-text items: 244 generated, 227 of them complete.
- Chunked translation improved; results that shrank long articles into summaries are rejected and page clutter removed.

releases.title: 改善访问速度与站点恢复能力
body: 优化后台查询，减少重复读取，并加强运行安全防护。
- 补齐站点恢复所需配置，提高故障后重新搭建的可靠性。

en.title: Faster page loads, stronger site recovery
body: Optimised back-office queries, cut duplicate reads and hardened runtime security.
- Added the configuration needed to restore the site, making a rebuild after a failure more reliable.

releases.title: 扩展历史资料范围，改善过刊采集
body: 增加历史资料入口与过刊翻页支持，补充今年各月的地理资讯。
- 部分期刊未提供摘要，仍会限制可用内容的数量。

en.title: Wider historical archive, better back-issue collection
body: Added a historical archive entrance and back-issue paging, filling in geographic news for each month of this year.
- Some journals provide no abstracts, which still limits how much content is usable.

releases.title: 新增机构、政务与期刊信源
body: 新增 173 条信源，覆盖机构政务信息与期刊当期目录，在采集信源增至 666 条。
- 移除无法采集的来源，并排除重复、无有效日期或与地理无关的候选。

en.title: New institutional, government and journal sources
body: Added 173 sources covering institutional, government and current journal contents; sources in collection rose to 666.
- Removed sources that could not be collected, and excluded duplicates, undated or non-geographic candidates.

releases.title: 扩展国内外官方与视频信源
body: 新增国内自然资源、地震、地调、水利等官方信息来源，扩展国际机构与学术资讯。
- 接入 96 个官方 YouTube 频道，并核对频道身份。

en.title: More official and video sources in China and abroad
body: Added official Chinese sources on natural resources, earthquakes, geology and water, plus international academic news.
- Connected 96 official YouTube channels and checked each channel's identity.

releases.title: 历史归档新增日报、周报与月报
body: 补充今年以来的历史刊物，可翻阅日报增至 279 期，另有 40 期周报和 9 期月报。
- 修复有资料却未出刊及部分刊物内容为空的问题。

en.title: Daily, weekly and monthly briefs join the archive
body: Added this year's back issues: browsable daily briefs rose to 279, plus 40 weekly and 9 monthly briefs.
- Fixed issues that had material but were never published, and some issues that came out empty.

releases.title: 补充今年以来的历史资料
body: 将资料范围扩展至今年 1 月以来，1—9 月每月已收集约千条历史材料。
- 历史材料仍按原有标准筛选，后续继续整理、翻译与出刊。

en.title: More historical material from this year
body: Coverage now reaches back to January; each month from January to September holds about a thousand historical items.
- Historical material is still filtered by the existing standard; organising, translation and publishing continue.

releases.title: 减少周报、月报缺期
body: 改善出刊中断后的接续处理，减少刊物反复等待的问题。
- 总述或大标题生成失败时，仍保留已选出的条目与栏目。

en.title: Fewer gaps in weekly and monthly briefs
body: Improved how publishing resumes after an interruption, so issues no longer wait over and over.
- When the overview or main headline fails to generate, the selected items and sections are kept.

releases.title: 精选与主题列表支持连续滚动
body: 精选和主题列表滚到末尾会自动加载下一页，无需反复点击。
- 遇到无法继续加载的情况会提供提示；列表失效时会返回第一页。

en.title: Selected and topic lists scroll on without clicking
body: The Selected and topic lists now load the next page at the bottom, with no repeated clicking.
- A message appears when loading cannot continue; if the list goes stale, it returns to the first page.

releases.title: 改善自动整理的连续性，更新内容说明
body: 增加内容处理渠道，减少单一渠道受限时对资讯整理的影响。
- 关于页与使用说明同步写明：标题、摘要和逐条判断由模型生成，标准由站长制定并可抽查更正。

en.title: Steadier automated processing, updated content notes
body: Added a second content processing channel, so limits on one channel no longer hold up the news pipeline.
- The About page and usage notes say titles, summaries and calls are model-generated; the site owner sets the standard.

releases.title: 修复历史翻页与栏目采集遗漏
body: 改善按月采集历史资料的翻页规则，避免遇到空页后停止处理后续内容。
- 修复带参数的文章链接被误认为栏目页的问题，恢复极地研究中心科研进展采集。

en.title: Fixed archive paging and missed section collection
body: Fixed the paging rules for month-by-month archive collection, so an empty page no longer stops later content.
- Fixed article links with parameters being read as section pages, restoring Polar Research Institute of China updates.

releases.title: 视频卡片支持看图，全部动态新增月历
body: 视频来源卡片可查看最多三张封面静帧，点击可放大。
- 「全部动态」新增月历，可按日期浏览更早内容，数量随分类与标签变化。

en.title: Video cards show stills; All updates gets a calendar
body: Cards from video sources now show up to three cover stills, and clicking one enlarges it.
- All updates now has a calendar to browse earlier content by date; counts follow the chosen category and tags.

releases.title: 改进发布日期识别
body: 按来源指定的日期格式读取，减少日、月顺序混淆。
- 无法可靠识别的日期保留为空，不猜测填写。
- 采集报告新增日期缺失提示，便于发现异常来源。

en.title: Better publication-date detection
body: Dates are read using each source's specified format, reducing confusion between day and month order.
- Dates that cannot be read reliably are left blank instead of being guessed.
- Collection reports now flag missing dates, making problem sources easier to spot.

releases.title: 新增法国地理院、卫星与大气等信源
body: 分两批接入 12 条来源，包括法国地理院、卫星与大气机构、期刊目录及科研动态。
- 只接入可实际获取内容的来源；返回空白、无有效正文或无法访问的候选暂不收录。

en.title: New sources: France's IGN, satellites and atmosphere
body: Added 12 sources in two batches: France's IGN, satellite and atmosphere agencies, journal contents and research updates.
- Only sources with content that can be fetched are connected; blank, unusable or unreachable candidates are left out.

releases.title: 修复「返回精选」，完善键盘菜单
body: 修复从条目页返回分类精选时错误显示 404 的问题。
- 「更多操作」菜单支持方向键及 Home、End，关闭后按操作方式恢复焦点。

en.title: Back to Selected fixed, keyboard menu improved
body: Fixed a 404 shown when returning from an item page to a category's Selected list.
- The More actions menu now supports the arrow keys and Home/End, and returns focus the way it was opened.

releases.title: 继续扩充地理学术信源
body: 新增两批共 65 条学术与研究动态来源，覆盖更多地理相关期刊。
- 按期刊官方目录核对名称，纠正缩写混淆，并移除重复来源。

en.title: More geography research sources
body: Added 65 academic and research-update sources in two batches, covering more geography-related journals.
- Names were checked against each journal's official contents, mixed-up abbreviations fixed, duplicates removed.

releases.title: 新增 95 条学术前沿信源
body: 扩充地理期刊、预印本、研究机构与高校科研动态，支持浏览更多前沿成果。
- 修复部分期刊目录链接与标题解析问题。

en.title: 95 new frontier research sources
body: Expanded coverage of geography journals, preprints, research institutes and university research updates.
- Fixed contents links and title parsing for some journals.

releases.title: 新增「前沿地理」，调整分类名称
body: 新增「前沿地理」，收录新证据、新方法、新数据与研究进展。
- 移除「考研」分类，将「地理与政治」「地理与历史」改为「政治地理」「历史地理」。

en.title: Frontier Geography added; category names revised
body: Added Frontier Geography, covering new evidence, methods, data and research progress.
- Removed the postgraduate exam category; politics and history now read Political Geography and Historical Geography.

releases.title: 归档标明未出刊日期，期号保持稳定
body: 归档会标出没有刊物的日期，空刊不再计入当月期数。
- 期号在出版时确定，重排不改号，后补的旧刊不打乱已有编号。

en.title: Archive marks days with no issue; issue numbers fixed
body: The archive now marks dates with no issue, and empty issues no longer count toward the month's total.
- Issue numbers are set at publication and stay fixed when issues are reordered; later backfills leave them alone.

releases.title: 调整精选门槛，恢复日报出刊
body: 根据实际评分结果下调入选门槛，让更多符合标准的内容进入精选。
- 按已有分析重新判定后，精选从 59 条增至 77 条，日报自次日起恢复。

en.title: Selection bar lowered; daily brief publishing resumes
body: Lowered the selection threshold to match actual scores, so more content that meets the standard enters Selected.
- After re-judging with existing analyses, Selected grew from 59 items to 77, and the daily brief resumed the next day.

releases.title: 新增六家地理与科学权威机构
body: 接入国际地理联合会、美国地理学家协会、国际制图协会、IPBES、国际科学理事会与联合国人居署。
- 六家来源已采集到内容，无法正常获取的候选暂未接入。

en.title: Six leading geography and science bodies added
body: Connected the International Geographical Union and the American Association of Geographers.
Added the International Cartographic Association, IPBES, the International Science Council and UN-Habitat.
- All six sources have yielded content; candidates that could not be fetched were not connected for now.

releases.title: 查明精选过少与日报空刊的原因
body: 检查发现入选门槛与实际评分分布不匹配，导致精选较少，连续三期日报为空。
- 本轮仅确认原因，门槛调整见后续更新。

en.title: Why Selected was thin and three daily briefs empty
body: An audit found the selection threshold did not match actual scores, leaving Selected thin and three daily briefs empty.
- This round only confirmed the cause; the threshold change follows in a later update.

releases.title: 减少内容处理中断，保留摘要来源标记
body: 改善内容处理的等待与重试，减少任务因超时而反复中断。
- 摘要会持续保留人工或自动生成的标记，避免历史记录清理后误判作者来源。

en.title: Fewer processing stalls; summary origin labels kept
body: Improved waiting and retries in content processing, so tasks stop breaking off on timeouts.
- Summaries keep their manual or auto-generated label, so clearing old records no longer misattributes authorship.

releases.title: 统一刊物、信源数量与公开内容
body: 关于页和归档只统计真正可阅读的刊物，报道来源数量与展开列表保持一致。
- 修复部分已完成分析的内容未能发布，以及暂缓任务未能继续处理的问题。

en.title: Consistent figures for editions, sources and public content
body: The About page and the archive now count only editions that can actually be read, and a report's source count matches its expanded list.
- Fixed some analysed content that never reached publication, and jobs that had stalled instead of continuing.

releases.title: 清除正文中的页脚与网页控件
body: 改善正文提取，去除版权页脚、字号按钮、发稿信息和独立编辑署名等杂项。
- 本轮误清的有效正文已按备份恢复并重新处理。
- 公开页面仍以摘要和原文链接为主。

en.title: Page footers and web controls removed from article bodies
body: Body extraction now strips copyright footers, font-size buttons, publication notices and standalone editor bylines.
- Valid text removed by this round was restored from backup and processed again.
- Public pages still lead with the summary and a link to the original.

releases.title: 改善短预警识别与中文摘要生成
body: 较短的官方预警可按有效内容识别，减少被误判为无正文的情况。
- 修复中文摘要为空的问题，并修复或停用无法正常采集的信源。

en.title: Short alerts recognised; Chinese summaries no longer come out empty
body: Short official alerts are judged by their actual content instead of being mistaken for a body-less page.
- Fixed empty Chinese summaries, and repaired or paused sources that could not be collected.

releases.title: 启用模型生成中文标题、摘要与评分
body: 模型开始承担地理相关性判断、中文写作、评分与事件归并。
- 分类、信源与入选标准仍由站长制定，读者可反馈错误。

en.title: Models now write Chinese titles and summaries and give the score
body: Models now handle geographic relevance, Chinese writing, scoring and event grouping.
- Categories, sources and selection standards remain the editor's; readers can report mistakes.

releases.title: 登记官方 X 账号，暂未开启采集
body: 登记八家机构的官方 X 账号，等待采集条件具备后启用。
- 本轮试接的视频频道已撤下，尚未作为持续信源提供。
- 公开列表同时改为只提供仍可正常打开的条目。

en.title: Official X accounts registered, collection not yet switched on
body: Eight agencies' official X accounts are registered and will start once their collection conditions are met.
- The video channels tried this round were withdrawn and are not offered as standing sources.
- Public lists now include only items whose page still opens.

releases.title: 修复旧条目标题，统一列表与归档说明
body: 旧条目误用内部标签作标题时，改为显示来源原标题，并留空不可用摘要。
- 刊物条数、筛选后的更新时间与主题列表采用一致规则。

en.title: Old item titles corrected; lists and the archive explain themselves the same way
body: When an old item used an internal label as its title, the site now shows the source's own headline and leaves an unusable summary empty.
- Edition counts, filtered update times and topic lists now follow one rule.

releases.title: 改善总述生成与图片展示
body: 不可用的事件综述、日报导语和刊物总述可重新生成。
- 没有中文标题的精选不再自动进入站点索引。

en.title: Better overview generation and image display
body: Unusable event digests, daily leads and report overviews can be regenerated.
- Picks without a Chinese title no longer enter the site index automatically.

releases.title: 修复事件综述重写，检查推荐理由
body: 后台新增带理由的事件综述重写入口，修复重复取回已拒绝文本的问题。
- 推荐理由与标题、摘要采用相同的身份与中文检查。
- 旧的规则拼接综述可重新生成。

en.title: Event digests can be rewritten again; selection reasons are checked
body: The back office now has a rewrite entry for an event digest with a reason, and no longer fetches an already-rejected text a second time.
- Selection reasons go through the same identity and Chinese checks as titles and summaries.
- Old rule-built digests can be regenerated.

releases.title: 修复大量收藏的检查遗漏
body: 收藏超过 500 条时会分批检查完整清单，减少后续收藏未被查询的问题。
- 统一报道来源数量与列表规则，搜索繁忙时提供实际等待提示。

en.title: Fixed a check that missed large saved lists
body: Once a reader saves more than 500 items, the full list is checked in batches, so later saves are no longer skipped.
- Report source counts and list rules now agree, and a busy search says how long the wait is.

releases.title: 事件页明确提示尚无中文稿
body: 尚无中文稿的事件页会说明标题与报道按原文显示，并保留原始报道入口。
- 移除未由编辑撰写的旧导语，日报保留条目，周报、月报使用通用期名。

en.title: Event pages say plainly when there is no Chinese draft
body: An event page with no Chinese draft now explains that titles and reports are shown as published, and keeps the original report entrances.
- Removed old leads the editors did not write; the daily keeps its items, and the weekly and monthly use a plain issue name.

releases.title: 新增中文官方与新闻信源
body: 分两批接入中新网、BBC 中文、教育部、中国科技网与发改委动态。
- 未持续更新或在采集端无法获取的候选暂未启用。

en.title: New Chinese official and news sources
body: China News Service, BBC Chinese, the Ministry of Education, China Science and Technology Network and NDRC updates were added in two batches.
- Candidates that do not update steadily, or cannot be fetched, stay off.

releases.title: 简化首页筛选栏
body: 移除与「全部」高度重合的「一手」筛选项，保留分类筛选。
- 事件页的「官方一手」筛选与来源标记继续提供，旧渠道链接仍可打开。

en.title: A simpler filter row on the home page
body: Removed the “first-hand” filter, which overlapped almost entirely with “All”, and kept the category filters.
- The event page's official/first-hand filter and source marks stay, and old channel links still open.

releases.title: 热点榜保留最近一张有效榜单
body: 本轮没有合格事件时，首页展示最近一张有内容的榜单，并注明截至时间。
- 榜单超过一天会显示说明，并提供「全部动态」入口。
- 热点入选条件保持不变。

en.title: The trending board keeps the last ranking with content
body: When a round has no qualifying event, the home page shows the last ranking that had entries and states its cut-off time.
- A ranking older than a day says so and offers the All updates entrance.
- The conditions for entering the board are unchanged.

releases.title: 撤下重复板块，保留分类入口
body: 撤下与分类、主题功能重合的四个板块页，原板块地址停止提供。
- 条目与分类继续保留，读者可通过分类列表浏览。
- 本轮新增的 14 条信源继续采集。

en.title: Duplicate board pages removed, category entrances kept
body: The four board pages that duplicated categories and topics were removed, and their old addresses stop being served.
- Items and categories remain; readers browse through the category lists.
- The 14 sources added this round keep collecting.

releases.title: 修复中文内容发布与地震采集遗漏
body: 恢复内容处理更新，所有公开出口统一执行中文标题要求。
- 改善错误输入提示，修复地震列表未继续读取较旧记录的问题。

en.title: Fixed Chinese content publication and a gap in earthquake collection
body: Content processing updates again, and every public exit applies the Chinese-title requirement the same way.
- Better messages for bad input, and the earthquake list now keeps reading older records.

releases.title: 改善窄屏筛选与键盘阅读
body: 窄屏分类栏增加可横向滚动的提示，方便找到右侧分类。
- 改善键盘焦点提示与评分文字对比度。
- 相对时间改为向下取整，减少过早显示「两分钟前」的情况。

en.title: Better narrow-screen filters and keyboard reading
body: The category row on narrow screens now hints that it scrolls, so the categories on the right can be found.
- Clearer keyboard focus and higher contrast on the score text.
- Relative times now round down, so “two minutes ago” no longer appears too early.

releases.title: 合并重复分类，移除多余主题
body: 合并「地理信息技术」与「地理信息系统」，统一为「地理信息系统」。
- 移除「野外与考察」「观点与解读」分类及同名主题，原条目按内容重新归类。

en.title: Duplicate categories merged, redundant topics removed
body: “Geographic information technology” and “Geographic information systems” are merged into “Geographic information systems”.
- The “Fieldwork and expeditions” and “Opinion and analysis” categories and their same-named topics were removed; their items were reclassified by content.

releases.title: 修复事件后续无法加载
body: 没有后续报道的事件显示空列表，不再误报「事件后续暂时无法加载」。
- 页面只在断网或服务异常时提供重试。
- 无发布日期的条目单独列出，不再归入「今天」。

en.title: Fixed event follow-ups that would not load
body: An event with no follow-up reports shows an empty list instead of the false “event follow-ups could not be loaded”.
- The page offers a retry only when the network or the service actually fails.
- Items without a publication date are listed separately instead of under “today”.

releases.title: 修复英文卡片，补充中文内容
body: 当时已显示的 12 条英文卡片补上中文标题与摘要，并更正一处地震震级表述。
- 尚无中文稿的条目暂不进入公开列表，原页面保留并说明原因。

en.title: English cards fixed, Chinese content added
body: The 12 English cards shown at the time received Chinese titles and summaries, and one earthquake magnitude was corrected.
- Items without a Chinese draft no longer enter public lists; their page stays and explains why.

releases.title: 事件进展可换序，导出名称更清楚
body: 事件进展新增「最新在前／最早在前」，方便从头了解事件。
- 导出文件使用本站名称，相关文字统一为「事件提要」等表述。

en.title: Event developments can be reordered; exported names are clearer
body: Event developments can now be ordered “newest first” or “oldest first”, to follow an event from the start.
- Exported files use this site's own name, and the wording is unified around “event digest”.

releases.title: 空刊不再进入归档与订阅列表
body: 没有内容的刊物不再进入归档、月份网格、前后导航与「最新一期」。
- 旧地址仍可打开并说明没有入选内容，零字数刊物不再显示虚构的阅读时长。

en.title: Empty editions no longer enter the archive or subscription lists
body: An edition with no content no longer enters the archive, the month grid, the neighbour links or “latest issue”.
- Its old address still opens and says there was no selected content; a zero-word edition no longer shows a made-up reading time.

releases.title: 周报、月报支持 RSS、API 与助手读
body: 新增周报、月报的往期列表、最新一期与指定期查询，并支持 MCP 读取。
- RSS 新增周报与月报订阅，各保留最近 12 期，附总述和栏目目录。

en.title: Weekly and monthly reports now read through RSS, the API and assistants
body: Added past-issue lists, the latest issue and per-issue queries for weekly and monthly reports, readable through MCP.
- RSS gained weekly and monthly subscriptions, each keeping the last 12 issues with the overview and a page index.

releases.title: 修复站内链接与介绍页配图
body: 修复多处站内链接跳出 GEOHOT 路径的问题，改善返回与功能入口。
- 核对介绍页配图、链接和发布文件，减少图片缺失或内容不一致。

en.title: Fixed on-site links and About-page images
body: Fixed several on-site links that left the GEOHOT path, and improved the back links and feature entrances.
- Checked the About page's images, links and published files, reducing missing images and inconsistent copy.

releases.title: 改善键盘、读屏与无脚本阅读
body: 改善信源名单展开后的焦点移动与读屏提示，增大部分小按钮的点击范围。
- 修正页面规范地址，并说明关闭 JavaScript 后可用与受限的功能。

en.title: Better keyboard, screen-reader and no-script reading
body: Improved focus movement and screen-reader notes after a source list expands, and enlarged some small buttons' tap areas.
- Corrected the canonical page address and explained which features work without JavaScript and which are limited.

releases.title: GEOHOT 正式上线并开源
body: 网站上线 xxc2007.me/geohot/，源码以 MIT 协议公开。
- 桌面侧栏与手机「更多」页新增开源仓库入口。

en.title: GEOHOT is live and open source
body: The site opened at xxc2007.me/geohot/, and the source is public under the MIT licence.
- The desktop sidebar and the phone's More page gained an entrance to the open-source repository.

releases.title: 地理热点上线
body: 站名启用 GEOHOT（地理热点），内容转向地理领域。
- 资讯摘要着重说明地点、影响范围与消息来源，面向泛读者解释术语。

en.title: GEOHOT goes live
body: The site takes the name GEOHOT (Geography Hotspots) and turns to geography.
- Summaries now state place, reach and source, and explain technical terms for general readers.

releases.title: 按空间影响与证据筛选地理资讯
body: 精选改从影响范围、新意、证据等维度判断，信源转向台网、机构、期刊与研究者。
- 减少旅游营销、招生推广与未经核实传闻。

en.title: Selecting geographic news by spatial impact and evidence
body: Selection now judges reach, novelty and evidence, and sources turn to station networks, agencies, journals and researchers.
- Less travel marketing, study-tour promotion and unverified rumour.

releases.title: 地理日报突出位置、尺度与影响
body: 日报按空间影响组织头条，导语交代地点、范围、时间与消息来源。
- 日报、周报和月报按北京时间排期发布。

en.title: The daily brief leads with place, scale and impact
body: The daily orders its lead by spatial impact, and its opening states place, reach, time and source.
- Daily, weekly and monthly editions are scheduled in Beijing time.
